docs.title: Allure
docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/lixiewulf/allure Stars 230 Last updated 2026-04-09T23:52:42Z

Contributors: Sh1penfire (world logic)

⚠ PERFORMANCE WARNING: This mod may crash or misbehave on weaker PCs and phones.

Best played with a completely fresh campaign save.

Currently in development. Description will try to increase player engagement later.

Allure is a large RTS mod that attempts to bring a true start-to-finish storyline to the table. And also hardcore gameplay. Enjoy being swarmed by the bee legion.

This mod is planned to introduce an overhauled vanilla experience, with sweeping changes across every aspect of Serpulo. Maps are redone, tutorials added.

What comes after? Well, I guess we'll have to find out. I'm not giving you any spoilers. You'll find out if you're curious.

Enabling this mod will break every Serpulo schematic until disabled. Be careful, well, if you like yours.

Works on beta build 157. Edit the mod.hjson's minGameVersion to use.

docs.title: Steam

docs.title: Infested Valley
docs.text:
A narrow, isolated valley in the northern mountains.

Two small enemy bases have built up here. Eradicate them with Minke units and take their new research. Expect attacks from two sides.

docs.title: Jagged Heights
docs.text: Jagged, sharp shale cliffs lie infested with enemy infrastructure to the north. The enemy appears to have engineered a new drill here, faster than your basic drills. Eradicate the bases quickly. Push the enemy back. Steal their pneumatic drills, and perhaps find a new alternative.

docs.title: Overgrown Basin
docs.text: Once a lush basin, now overtaken by spores. The enemy has set up a production base here. Claim it for your own. Use your new Flare units to whittle them down. Use Crawler units to open breaches for your daggers.

docs.title: Plagued Islands
docs.text: A small, infested lake lies nestled between frigid mountain ranges. Spore has devastated the land, spreading rapidly over the marshes. The enemy has built a major production factility here. Steal their Nova and silicon smelter blueprints. Use this new unit against them.

docs.title: Power Research Outpost
docs.text: The ruins of a long-abandoned research base lie in the untainted mountains to the south. Extensive flooding has destroyed most of the advanced technology here. The enemy is starting to notice our presence globally. Research the Arc turret and steam generator. Fend off the enemy's army.

docs.title: Asthosus
docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/catana791/asthosus Stars 244 Last updated 2026-06-27T11:27:19Z

A mod that adds a new planet, Asthosus, into the game.

Asthosus is a deserted planet. A wasteland filled with danger.

It has a fully playable campaign with 11 campaign and 21 optional maps.

Aside from these 32 maps, Asthosus contains over 180 pieces of unique content,

including blocks, liquids, items, units and status effects.

This number is not counting any internal units or environment blocks/tiles.

I aimed to re-use nearly no vanilla content and instead fill the mod

with new and (hopefully) exciting things.

The mod comes with it's own custom music, made by ThePythonGuy3!

If you find any issues or want to tell me anything else,

feel free to join the Asthosus Discord server.

The same thing goes for when you need help with this mod.

Asthosus is available in the following languages:

  • English

  • German

  • Indonesian

  • Russian

  • Ukrainian

  • Traditional Chinese

  • Simplified Chinese

Enjoy!

docs.title: Resource Entry - Ferrinite
docs.text:
Location: The Barrens, a biome on Asthosus where conditions are relatively stable compared to the rest of the planet. This area is defined by vast stretches of quicksand floors, lignite deposits, geothermal vents and the remains of dead plant life. While it's not free from hazards, the Barrens offer a much safer environment for initial operation.

Composition: Ferrinite is a rock-like material, formed from the natural fusion of sand and mineral deposits. The intense heat that is present on Asthosus hardened the material into a dense, stone-like substance, making it a useful resource for early construction.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Demetite
docs.text:
Location: The Barrens, a biome on Asthosus where geothermal vents and mineral-rich deposits create ideal conditions for Demetite's formation. Often found alongside Ferrinite, this metallic resource is extracted from the same resource-rich regions.

Composition: Demetite is a metallic material formed through the natural fusion of minerals under pressure. Its soft, metallic composition makes it suitable for basic building, though it is not durable enough to be used by itself in advanced construction.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Lignite
docs.text:
Location: Found in the Barrens and the Desert regions of Asthosus. Lignite appears close to walls where flora once thrived, particularly where ancient organic depots have been buried and compressed.

Composition: Lignite is a low-grade, coal-like material created through the partial decomposition of long-dead plant matter. Its porous, brittle structure allows for easy ignition, making it valuable for heating and basic combustion.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Hardened Sand
docs.text:
Location: Found primarily in the desert biomes on Asthosus. Hardened Sand forms where loose sediment is exposed to sustained heat, causing natural compression over time.

Composition: Hardened Sand is the result of intense thermal exposure to standard sand deposits and sediment in general. The process fuses grains into a denser, more compact material. Though it lacks the structural strength of stone or metal, it serves as a useful intermediary in the refinement of simple construction resources.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Red Sand
docs.text:
Location: Found exclusively in the Mesa biome of Asthosus. Red Sand is easily identified by its vibrant hue and granular texture, often blanketing the steep, stratified slopes and valley of the region.

Composition: Red Sand is composed of oxizdized mineral particles and weathered sediment, bearing subtle traces of various elemental materials. Its coloration stems from high ferric or iron content, oxidized over countless cycles of exposure to heat and wind.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Lodestone
docs.text:
Location: Manufactured within specialized mixing facilities using base components from the Barrens and the Dessert. Though naturally occuring magnetic rock exists on Asthosus, it is unreachable through common means, requiring artificial production instead.

Composition: A compact, magnetically reactive compound, Lodestone results from the physical blending of dense mineral and sediment-based materials. While lacking the same level of magnetization that can be found in naturally occuring Lodestone, the mixture forms a stable structure with conductive properties useful in automated systems and transport.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Lithium
docs.text:
Location: Manufactured through industrial refinement rather than mined. Lithium is produced in grinders - facilities that extract and refine reactive elements from Lignite and Demetite under abrasion.

Composition: A soft, pale material with high charge potential and chemical sensitivity. The process of converting raw combustible and metallic matter into usable Lithium is efficient but must be closely monitored due to the flammable ingredients involved.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Cretite
docs.text:
Location: Produced in Cretite Mixers, specialized industrial facilities that combine Lignite, Lithium, and Red Sand. The result is a volatile composite material, primarily used in controlled explosions or as a powerful energy source when carefully managed.

Composition: Cretite is a chemically reactive and highly unstable mixture of Lignite, Lithium, and Red Sand. The interaction of these elements under controlled constants results in a compound that is flammable and slightly explosive, with immense potential energy when harnessed properly.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Crystalline Geode
docs.text:
Location: Found on the surface around the walls of the Igneous Biome, where the terrain is harsh and molten slag pools are abundant. These geodes can be spotted near the edges of this biome, making them both dangerous but also rewarding to gather and access.

Composition: Obsidian crystals, encased in thick Ferrinite layers, form these geodes. The intense heat from surrounding molten slag speeds up the natural formation of these protective layers, making these geodes more difficult to extract.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Obsidian
docs.text:
Location: Found in the Igneous Biome and areas with abundant molten slag. Obsidian is not directly mined; instead, it is extracted through specialized methods such as geode cracking or slag cooling.

Composition: Obsidian is a naturally occuring volcanic glass formed under extreme heat. Due to its hardness and durability, it is sought after for advanced building and specialized equipment.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Irradiated Lump
docs.text:
Location: Typically found in the Radiant Expanse, a vast and treacherous biome where natural radiation saturates the environment. The irradiated materials in this area are abundant yet extremely dangerous to interact with.

Composition: A radioactive mineral, the Irradiated Lump holds no practical value in its raw form. Its high radioactivity makes it hazardous to handle without proper protective measures, and it cannot be directly used in construction or production. Its structure is porous and brittle.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Barite
docs.text:
Location: Found primarily in the Radiant Expanse, this mineral is a refined product of Irradiated Lump, processed in specialized facilities designed to handle its dangerous properties.

Composition: Barite is a highly radioactive mineral with various applications in high-tier building, power production, and crafting. It is a dense and durable resource that plays a crucial role in constructing more advanced technologies and structures. The mineral is known for its significant radioactivity, which is both a danger and an asset, depending on its use.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Crosium
docs.text:
Location: Crosium is created in a specialized facility called the Crosium Infuser, where Obsidian, Pressure, and Purified Oasis Water are combined under controlled conditions. This unique process allows the material to take on properties that are highly valued in advanced building and unit creation.

Composition: Crosium is a versatile material with a remarkable ability to shift between being electrically insulative and conductive depending on the handling process. Its molecular structure gives it an unusual adaptability, making it essential for high-tech applications, from intricate building systems to the creation of specialized units and machinery.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Vesmonium
docs.text:
Location: Vesmonium is produced in the Vesmonium Accultor, a specialized facility where Lignite, Barite, Pressure, and Liquid Barite are combined under controlled conditions. This unique mixture results in a material with slightly charged, flammable, and radioactive properties, commonly used in advanced building, defensive structures, and crafting.

Composition: Vesmonium is a highly reactive material formed through a complex process involving the blending of volatile substances. Its slight charge, flammability, and moderate radioactivity make it a critical resource for high-tech applications but also a dangerous one to manage.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Draysten
docs.text:
Location: Draysten is crafted in the Draysten Crucible, a high-tech facility where Vesmonium, Nontragen, and Heat are combined to create this advanced alloy. Due to the complex nature of its production process, Draysten is an extremely expensive material, especially given the resource-heavy requirements of Vesmonium in its creation.

Composition: Draysten is a slightly charged and highly flammable alloy formed by infusing Vesmonium with Nontragen using extreme heat. The resulting material is a potent combination of charge, explosiveness, and moderate radioactivity, making it ideal for lategame applications in building and unit creation.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Pressure
docs.text:
Location: Pressure is one of the most vital and commonly used resources across Asthosus, powering an array of machines, generators, and other devices essential to life and operations. Found in natural reserves deep underground or extracted through specialized equipment, it serves as the lifeblood for countless operations.

Composition: Pressure itself is a gaseous material under extreme conditions, harnessed and utilized for its ability to generate energy when released in controlled settings. It is a fundamental component of many Asthosian machines, turbines, and energy systems, often stored in high-pressure containers or used in real-time processes to power technology. Despite its potential for catastrophic explosions under improper management, it remains an indispensable part of Asthosian industry.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Silicon Tetrafluoride
docs.text:
Location: Silicon Tetrafluoride is a highly volatile gas that, while dangerous, is a necessary component in a variety of advanced Asthosian systems, especially in the cooling mechanisms for weaponry and resource refinement processes. Found primarily in research and industrial facilities, its role is critical to maintaining the efficiency and safety of certain high-energy systems. The gas itself is harnessed by Geothermal Accumulators from Asthosian vents.

Composition: Silicon Tetrafluoride is a gaseous compound, highly reactive with water and moisture, and capable of inducing severe damage if mishandled. Despite its toxicity, it serves a vital role in the cooling processes for turrets and certain resource refinement techniques, where its properties allow it to absorb and dissipate heat efficiently. Its danger lies not only in its reactive nature but also in its explosive potential when subjected to high temperatures or improper containment.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Oasis Water
docs.text:
Location: Oasis Water is a rare and vital liquid sourced from oases found within the desert biomes of Asthosus. These oases, which are few and far between, serve as the only significant reservoirs of liquid in the otherwise dry and hostile landscape.

Composition: Oasis Water is distinguished by its unusually high concentration of minerals, which gives it unique properties compared to typical water. The elevated mineral content increases its boiling point, preventing it from evaporating instantly in the extreme temperatures of Asthosus. This makes it crucial for use as a coolant, particularly in environments where regular water would evaporate too quickly to be useful. Its mineral concentration also makes it a highly effective thermal conductor, able to absorb and dissipate heat much more efficiently than standard liquids.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Purified Oasis Water
docs.text:
Location: Purified Oasis Water is derived from the mineral-rich Oasis Water found in desert biomes on Asthosus. After being extracted, the water undergoes a filtration process to remove any contaminants, ensuring that only the highest quality liquid remains.

Composition: Purified Oasis Water is the result of Oasis Water that has been carefully filtered using a specialized sieve. This filtration process removes impurities, leaving the water in a pristine state ideal for technical applications. While still maintaining its high mineral concentration, Purified Oasis Water is now free from the natural contaminants present in raw Oasis Water. Its improved composition enhances its use as a superior coolant and makes it more effective in delicate machinery or advanced systems that require a higher level of purity.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Liquid Barite
docs.text:
Location: Liquid Barite is a highly unstable, radioactive form of Barite, only found in the most extreme conditions. This fluid form is capable of spreading quickly and causing damage to anything it comes into contact with. Its caustic nature and the radiation it emits make it one of the most dangerous liquids on Asthosus. However, when cooled and processed through a Barite Cooler, Liquid Barite can be hardened back into solid Barite, a useful material for advanced building and crafting.

Composition: Liquid Barite retains many of the properties of its solid counterpart, but in a more unstable, liquid state. Its high radioactivity makes it extremely dangerous to handle, and it emits a faint but persistent radiation field. Anything that comes into contact with Liquid Barite becomes exposed to this radiation and is damaged as a result. Its high viscosity and explosiveness make it a potential hazard in large quantities.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Nontragen
docs.text:
Location: Nontragen is a sophisticated and highly specialized gas, produced through a unique process that involves pressurizing Oasis Water and Powderized Obsidian. This gas plays a crucial role in advanced cooling systems and high-tech production processes on Asthosus. Its unique properties make it invaluable for high-efficiency applications, particularly in environments where extreme temperatures are a challenge. Nontragen is recognized for its thermal stability, which allows it to serve as a powerful coolant in systems requiring constant, regulated temperatures.

Composition: Nontragen is a gas with a distinct thermal signature, making it a critical component in managing the heat generated by advanced machinery and facilities on the planet. The synthesis process, which involves the combination of Oasis Water and Powderized Obsidian under intense pressure, results in a gas with impressive heat capacity and a stable cooling effect. It can withstand high temperatures and regulate cooling in systems that would otherwise be vulnerable to overheating. The unique mixture of ingredients gives Nontragen a subtle but noticeable color and texture, a distinguishing factor for working with it.

docs.title: Asthosus
docs.text: A deserted planet, filled with dangers but also possibilities. Good luck!

docs.title: [red]Trecara - Work in Progress!
docs.text: Asthosus moon, a lush stellar body that contains an abundance of water and fauna. Ores are exceedingly rare here so use what you have to conquer this planet.

docs.title: Genesis
docs.text: You land on Asthosus and find yourself in a small ravine devoid of life and resources. Can you really conquer this planet?

docs.title: Ignition
docs.text:
Small deposits of Lignite have formed via geothermal activity.

Start to venture into electric power.

docs.title: Lattice
docs.text: Scattered boulders of resources dot the area. Prevent the enemy from harnessing them. Expand quickly. Utilize Lodestone to defend against stronger foes.

docs.title: Fulge
docs.text:
You land on a small sector. This is the perfect opportunity to research and use Lithium.

Set up Lithium production. Bring down the enemy on this sector.

A powerful geomagnetic storm is wrecking havoc here. It appears to affect both you and the enemy.

Modifiers: - Enemies deal 10% increased damage. - Enemies have 25% more health. - Your buildings have 15% less health.

docs.title: Immist
docs.text:
The enemy has entrenched inside a deserted area.

Upon landing, they will mount an assault. Defend the core from enemy fire.

Research unit production technologies. Remove the enemy foothold.

docs.title: Igneous Peaks
docs.text:
This sector contains high-temperature biomes. These contain a new resource for you to use, Obsidian.

Produce Obsidian and use it to bring down this sectors guardian.

docs.title: Detriment Valley
docs.text:
A sector that has survived many bombings. The enemy has gathered a formidable force here.

Venture into producing Barite.

Create stronger defenses. Push back the enemy in this sector.

Modifiers: - Enemies have 15% more health. - Enemies deal 15% more damage. - Enemies move 10% faster.

docs.title: Defringe
docs.text:
An old production complex lies here, idle for thousands of years. Kickstart its self-repair capabilities. Utilize Vesmonium for defense.

Do not be fooled by the large wave spacing. This is a key site of enemy interest.

Utilize old, dead constructs left after each failed attempt to secure a foothold. Defeat the powerful guardian that is protecting this sector.

Modifiers: - Enemies are equipped with a speed bost. -Solar Heater Panels are unavailable. -Deconstructing Derelict structures yields less resources.

docs.title: Synthesis Facility
docs.text:
The enemy is approaching from two sides at the same time.

Venture into the creation of Crosium. Defend and capture this challenging sector.

docs.title: Furnace Settlement
docs.text:
The enemy has created an extremely powerful base here.

Furthermore, the enemy is deploying forces from two drop zones at the same time. Some of their most powerful guardians have been ordered to put a stop to your campaign.

Venture into the creation of Draysten. Bring down the enemy waves and destroy their massive base.

docs.title: Omega
docs.text:
The last and final frontier.

The enemy has gathered all remaining forces and will attack relentlessly.

Be prepared to fight back from multiple frontlines at the same time.

The enemy has secured their drop zones with a massive base.

Bring this base down. It might be a good idea to first secure your own zones and production before launching your attack.

docs.title: Maar
docs.text:
You find yourself on a small sector with lots of Oasis Water.

This sector lends itself perfectly for Lodestone production.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Chasm
docs.text:
This sector may prove useful for additional Lithium production.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Inferate
docs.text:
You stumble across a large base.

After you have captured Immist, you wonder how many more bases you have to face.

The enemy has built defenses in layers. Bring them down one by one.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Clamor
docs.text:
It appears this sector is rich in resources.

Arumis tier 5 guardians have been sighted.

Take them down. Claim this sector for yourself.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Embage
docs.text:
You find yourself on a very tight and claustrophobic sector filled with danger.

The enemy is relentless. Push them back in the limited space provided.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Factory Unit 0047
docs.text:
One of the many massive factory units left that were created by the Arumis.

This production complex lies abandoned, most of it's defensive capabilities having withered away.

The enemy is unattentative.

Modifiers: - You can use turrets to attack the enemy base.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Magmatic Riverbed
docs.text:
A vast slag riverbed is housing in this area. Enormous volcanic activities resulted in harsh terrain, proving most units being useless to attack.

The enemies set up a large, heavily protected outpost here.

Modifiers: - Only Hover units are usable. - Enemy structure have 50% more health. - Enemies deal 50% more damage. - Your structures have 20% more health. - You build 50% faster. - Your unit production is 50% faster. - You can only deposit into the core. - Deconstructed structures refund no materials.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Barite Valley
docs.text:
You find yourself on an unexplored sector. This sector seems to be home to strange, mutated creatures. They appear to be somehow organic.

Survive the waves of mutant creatures. Secure a foothold.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Lucila
docs.text:
Just when you researched everything you need to create Barite, your Barite Quern techonolgy gets stolen by the enemy.

Utilize Barite Coolers to create Barite instead. Create higher-tier units to take down the multiple bases here.

Modifiers: - Barite Querns are unavailable. - Utilize Barite Coolers to create Barite.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Bioweapon Facility
docs.text:
A large research facility that was taken over by barite creatures. It once contained dangerous biological weapons.

Now the hives control the entire base.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Oasis Delta
docs.text:
Separated by a massive river of oasis water, an untouched region lies separated from a huge enemy base.

Utilize Vesmonium to create high-tier units. Bring this base down.

The enemy will fight back with full power. Be prepared.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Preciptum
docs.text:
Once a massive area used for weapon tests.

A major part of this sectors terrain has been turned into a gaping void by a devastating explosion.

The enemy has created a base on the remnants of this land.

Take it down.

Modifiers: - Enemy units deal 50% more damage. - Enemy buildings have 50% more health. - Your unit production is 50% slower. - Fog of War is present here.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Abandoned Research Center
docs.text:
The enemy has created a mighty base with multiple cores here. Higher tier units will be required to take it down.

Act Fast. Expand quickly. Take down the enemy base before the enemy forces take you down.

Modifiers: - Enemy units deal 15% more damage. - Enemy structures have 25% more health. - Enemy structures deal 25% more damage.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Thanatos
docs.text:
An outlying sector that contains abundant resources considering its size.

The enemy appears to have little presence here. Or do they...

Fight heaps of enemies and guardians. Take this sector for yourself.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Caldoria
docs.text:
Scans indicate that this sector contains no Crystalline Geodes.

The enemy force cannot be calculated.

Take this sector for yourself.

Modifiers: - There are no Crystalline Geodes present. - Use Slag Cooling Molds to create Obsidian. - Low-Tier Tech is unusable here.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Molten Heights
docs.text:
Due to massive amounts of volcanic activity, the area is flooded with slag. The higher regions of the terrain remain untouched.

The enemy values this sector greatly. Prepare for merciless waves.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Mune
docs.text:
Units equipped with superbuffed shield generators have been sent to stop you.

Retaliate with your most powerful weapons.

Modifiers: - Enemies deal 25% increased damage from all sources. - Enemies possess a multitude of their health as shields.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Inferno Bastion
docs.text:
This area is rich in resources due to high volcanic activity, due to which the sector was flooded with heaps of slag.

Enemies have settled here long ago but were taken over by the barite creatures.

Take back the base from these creatures while avoiding the molten mass and building your infrastructure around it.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

Transmission lost, data unavailable.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Finistera
docs.text:
You land on a claustrophobic, cramped sector.

The enemy has found great value in this sector.

They are attacking from 4 directions. Some drop zones will activate after a while, others will be active the entire time.

A large population of Barite Creatures is also present here. Take down their hives.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Acropolis
docs.text:
You stumble upon a strangely shaped sector.

The enemy appears to have created the most powerful base you have ever seen here.

Take it down. High-tier units will be required.

It appears that the base is built in stages. Perhaps you should defeat the stages starting with the weakest one.

Consider securing the limited space you have before attacking.

Expand as much as you can.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.text: Protects the Hyphos core. Equipped with a single missile launcher. Capable of building and mining.

docs.title: Luminary
docs.text: Capable of building and automatically repairing damaged structures. Equipped with a small healing beam.

docs.title: Enlighten
docs.text: Capable of building and automatically repairing damaged structures. Assists other units in construction. Equipped with a healing beam and arc cannon.

docs.title: Illuminate
docs.text: Capable of building and automatically repairing damaged structures. Assists other units in construction. Equipped with artillery and heal cannons.

docs.title: Elucidate
docs.text: Capable of building and automatically repairing damaged structures. Equipped with dual artillery and heal cannons. Projects a shield to protect nearby allied units.

docs.title: Expound
docs.text: Capable of building and automatically repairing damaged structures. Equipped with a double barrel healing launcher, a piercing heal laser array and two missile launchers.

docs.title: Zeta
docs.text: Defends the Essence core. Builds structures and mines ores.

docs.title: Theta
docs.text: Defends the Substratum core. Builds structures and mines ores.

docs.title: Iota
docs.text: Defends the Omphalos core. Builds structures and mines ores.

docs.title: Erpode
docs.text: Defends the Petra core. Has no offensive capabilities but is able to build, mine and support.

docs.title: Hirude
docs.text: Defends the Silex core. Has no offensive capabilities but is able to build, mine and support.

docs.title: Clitelle
docs.text: Defends the Summit core. Has very little offensive capabilities but is able to build, mine and support.

docs.title: Arcana Blob
docs.text: Created by a Primal Monolith, this alien creature spews out purple flames to attack.

docs.title: Arcana Raynoid
docs.text: A crab-like creature that is heavily armored and has dangerous offensive capabilities.

docs.title: Barite Crawler
docs.text: A strange lifeform that was born in Asthosus' radioactive biomes.

docs.title: Barite Elder
docs.text: A strange lifeform that was born in Asthosus' radioactive biomes. It appears to be the pinnacle of these creatures evolution.

docs.title: Barite Scourge
docs.text: A strange lifeform that was born in Asthosus' radioactive biomes.

docs.title: Barite Stalker
docs.text: A strange lifeform that was born in Asthosus' radioactive biomes.

docs.title: Arc Kiln
docs.text: Smelts sand into metaglass, utilizing rich heavy metals from the environment.

docs.title: [scarlet]Block Factory[]
docs.text: Fabricates structures up to 6x6 tiles in size. Needs coolant to forge blocks. Deprecated. Replace with the newer version.

docs.title: [scarlet]Wrong Constructor[]
docs.text: Forges bigger blocks. Needs water to process blocks. Deprecated. Replace with the newer version.

docs.title: Coffee Machine
docs.text: Uses water and grinds scrap to make coffee.

docs.title: Colloid Mixer
docs.text: Mixes siloxol and titanium powder to produce colloid, a liquid with high coolant capabilities.

docs.title: Electrofilter
docs.text: Separates siloxol into water and silica gases via electrolysis. Silicon cannot be collected in its gas form, and requires adjacent condensers.

docs.title: Fusion Chamber
docs.text: Mini fusion chamber. Uses water in a plasma state to generate carbon via atomic fusion. Outputs carbon in the form of graphite, and also generates power.

docs.title: Lancer Kiln
docs.text: Smelts sand into metaglass, utilizing rich heavy metals from the environment. Lead can be directly inputted if the environment is inadequate.

docs.title: [scarlet]Wrong Deconstructor[]
docs.text: Anuke how can you do this to me Deprecated. Replace with the newer version.

docs.title: Scalar Furnace
docs.text: Fuses various metals and materials into a light and dense metal, scalar alloy. The reaction produces large amounts of heat, which is used to generate power. Failure to input colloid will result in a catastrophe...

docs.title: Silicondenser
docs.text: Condenses and refines silica gas produced by adjacent electrofilters. Needs graphite to function.

docs.title: Large Blast Wall
docs.text: A highly explosive defensive block. Serves as explosive ammo for payload turrets. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Blast Wall
docs.text: A highly explosive defensive block. Serves as explosive ammo for payload turrets.

docs.title: Large Coal Wall
docs.text: A block made of packed fuel. When destroyed, combusts into persisting fires. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Coal Wall
docs.text: A block made of packed fuel. When destroyed, combusts into a persisting fire.

docs.title: Pyratite Crusher
docs.text: Smaller version of the crusher, repurposed as an offensive block. Damages blocks and units in front. The high speed and extreme temperature of the blades melt units quickly.

docs.title: Crusher
docs.text: Smaller version of the stone crusher, repurposed as an offensive block. Damages blocks and units in front. Cannot damage cores or banks of the same team. Does not deal damage to any allied blocks if "reactor explosions" is off.

docs.title: Large Frost Wall
docs.text: A low temperature but highly charged wall. Chills the attacker if it is hit. Explodes into an icy puddle when destroyed. Serves as explosive ammo for payload turrets. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Frost Wall
docs.text: A low temperature but highly charged wall. Chills the attacker if it is hit. Explodes into an icy puddle when destroyed. Serves as explosive ammo for payload turrets.

docs.title: Large Graphite Wall
docs.text: An absorbent defensive block. Absorbs physical reactions of bullets, such as frags, explosions or combustion. Cannot absorb lasers and electric arcs. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Graphite Wall
docs.text: An absorbent defensive block. Absorbs physical reactions of bullets, such as frags, explosions or combustion. Cannot absorb lasers and electric arcs.

docs.title: Large Lead Wall
docs.text: A moderately solid defensive block. Simple, and efficient as payload turret ammo. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Lead Wall
docs.text: A moderately solid defensive block. Simple, and efficient as payload turret ammo.

docs.title: Large Metaglass Wall
docs.text: A dense but fragile block. Explodes into fragments when destroyed. Serves as frag ammo for payload turrets. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Metaglass Wall
docs.text: A dense but fragile defensive block. Explodes into fragments when destroyed. Serves as frag ammo for payload turrets.

docs.title: Large Pyratite Wall
docs.text: A block made up of high-temperature matter. Violently bursts into flames when destroyed. Serves as incendiary ammo for payload turrets. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Pyratite Wall
docs.text: A block made up of high-temperature matter. Violently bursts into flames when destroyed. Serves as incendiary ammo for payload turrets.

docs.title: Large Silicon Wall
docs.text: A significantly solid defensive block. Somehow homes to foes when launched by payload turrets. Blocks electric arcs, but not lasers. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Silicon Wall
docs.text: A significantly solid block. Somehow homes to foes when launched by payload turrets. Blocks electric arcs, but not lasers.

docs.title: White Spike
docs.text: A spike that deals moderate melee damage to units. Only damages units that are going towards it, and can be placed in midair. Deals critical damage when rammed into units with pistons.

docs.title: Icicle
docs.text: A spike that deals high melee damage to units, and freezes them. Deals critical damage when rammed into units with pistons. Needs a solid block behind to work.

docs.title: Pyratite Spike
docs.text: A spike that deals low melee damage to units, and lights units on fire. Deals critical damage when rammed into units with pistons. Needs a solid block behind to work.

docs.title: Surge Spike
docs.text: A spike that deals moderate melee damage to units. Deals critical damage when rammed into units with pistons. Needs a solid block behind to work.

docs.title: Spike
docs.text: A spike that deals low melee damage to units. Deals critical damage when rammed into units with pistons. Needs a solid block behind to work.

docs.title: Team Block
docs.text: When broken, alerts everyone about the attack and the offender. Useful for teaming or traitor evidence in PvP, or just alerting a defense breach in survival.

docs.title: Armored Cog
docs.text: A cog twice as fast as a copper cog. Can spin up to 20 blocks in front around. Stays fixed when being spun by other cogs, like a non-inertial spinner. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: [scarlet]Block Packer[]
docs.text: Loads items into larger blocks. Deprecated. Replace with the newer version.

docs.title: [scarlet]Block Unpacker[]
docs.text: Unloads items into larger blocks. Deprecated. Replace with the newer version.

docs.title: Block Cloner
docs.text: Clones the block it is facing to the tile behind it. If the facing block is a payload block, the payload will be read, and the size limit will not be applied. Can only clone blocks that you should be able to place by yourself. Consumes items and power.

docs.title: Cog
docs.text: The primitive version of the spinner, still has the same functionality. Can spin up to 14 blocks in front around, the cog itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction. Can drop blocks to payload blocks, and with spore slimes can spin multiple blocks.

docs.title: Infinite Piston
docs.text: Can push up to 512 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Infinite Sticky Piston
docs.text: Can push or pull up to 512 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Sticky Piston
docs.text: Can push or pull up to 16 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls.

docs.title: Piston
docs.text: Can push up to 16 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls.

docs.title: Plastanium Cog
docs.text: A cog 1.5 times as fast as a copper cog. Slower than the titanium cog, but can spin the most blocks, up to 25 blocks in front around. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: Infirtia Spinner
docs.text: Can spin up to 120 blocks in front around. This version keeps spinning even when picked up by other spinners. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Inertia Spinner
docs.text: Can spin up to 16 blocks in front around. This version keeps spinning even when picked up by other spinners.

docs.title: Infinite Spinner
docs.text: Can spin up to 120 blocks in front around, the spinner itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction. Can drop blocks to payload blocks, and with spore slimes can spin multiple blocks. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Spinner
docs.text: The most advanced version of the cog, 4 times as fast as a copper cog. Can spin up to 16 blocks in front around, the spinner itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction. Can drop blocks to payload blocks, and with spore slimes can spin multiple blocks.

docs.title: Sided Spore Slime
docs.text: Only one side of it is sticky. Sticks to adjacent blocks. Does not stick to phase coating.

docs.title: Spore Slime
docs.text: Sticks to adjacent blocks. Does not stick to phase coating.

docs.title: Surge Slime
docs.text: Sticks to adjacent blocks, just like spore slimes. Conducts power to adjacent blocks. Does not stick to phase coating.

docs.title: Titanium Cog
docs.text: A cog twice as fast as a copper cog. Can spin up to 16 blocks in front around, the cog itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: Wooden Cog
docs.text: A cog twice as slow as a copper cog. Can spin up to 18 blocks in front around, the cog itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: Antique Shop
docs.text: Buy classic, retro and ancient legendary blocks with Anucoins. Merchandise changes every day! Some items may require bittrium, and Portal Invasion related merchandise can also be bought here.

docs.title: Anubank
docs.text: Central building responsible for managing the economy and the Anucoins. Can be linked to blocks that produce or consume Anucoins. Connect Anuvaults to increase capacity.

docs.title: Anusafe
docs.text: Increases the maximum anucoin capacity of the linked Anubank. Coins are transferred to the bank when unlinked, not left behind.

docs.title: Anuvault
docs.text: A larger Anusafe. Increases the maximum anucoin capacity of the linked Anubank. Coins are transferred to the bank when unlinked, not left behind.

docs.title: Byterium Shard
docs.text: A crystallized form of bittrium. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Box
docs.text: A cardboard box used for shipping merchandise all over the universe. One-use, automatically despawns once you take its contents.

docs.title: Cafe
docs.text: Buy beverages and snacks. Buy items using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Campfire
docs.text: Burns items and warms up nearby units. Handle with care, as pushing or spinning this block may result in fires spreading. Can hold more coal.

docs.title: Anucoin Source
docs.text: Maintains the Anucoin balance, removing or creating endless Anucoins when connected to an Anubank. Sandbox only. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with an Anucoin Node.

docs.title: Ion Source [accent]Beta[]
docs.text: Creates a resonating field of flowing ions, which causes all types of bullets to gain velocity in its general direction. The strange physics at effect here may cause unintentional behavior. The strong field of charge also push airborne payloads. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Icy Quartz
docs.text: A crystallized form of cryonite. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Discharger
docs.text: Stores power, but with a twist. Handle with care, as pushing or spinning this block will discharge its stored power in electric arcs.

docs.title: Extra Shop
docs.text: Buy item packages and perks using Anucoins. Buy items using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Coal Can
docs.text: Burns items and warms up nearby units. Handle with care, as pushing or spinning this block may result in fires spreading.

docs.title: Yutnori Stick Thrower
docs.text: Sticks of the Yutnori, a Korean traditional board game. Game Rules:  Do. Move one space forward.  Ge. Move two spaces forward.  Geol. Move three spaces forward.  Yut! Move four spaces forward, and roll again.  Mo! Move five spaces forward, and roll again.  Back-do. Move one space backward. If you are at the first space, your position will underflow and go right to the goal! You should also roll again when your move lands on an enemy space, sending the enemy to the start too. Rerolls stack, meaning one can win this game in just one turn, but extremely unlikely.

docs.title: Ion Jet
docs.text: Creates a field of flowing ions, which causes small bullets to gain velocity in its general direction. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Ion Thruster
docs.text: Creates a stronger field of flowing ions, which causes small bullets to gain velocity in its general direction. The strong field of charge also push airborne payloads. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Item Shop
docs.text: Buy items using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Omega Rune
docs.text: A stone rune that can convert kinetic energy into mana. Join the BetaMindy Omega Server to use this block.

docs.title: Present
docs.text: A holly jolly block. Click to unwrap, you don't know what's inside!

docs.title: Pressurised Container
docs.text: Stores items, and provides higher crafting output rates in payload furnaces.

docs.title: Sunstone
docs.text: A crystallized form of pyratite. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Scalar Crystal
docs.text: A crystallized form of raw scalar. Can be harvested with mynamites. Has special conductive properties, depending on the number of adjacent power blocks.

docs.title: Silo
docs.text: Stores an enormous amount of items of each type. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

docs.title: Space Opal
docs.text: A crystallized form of space matter. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Spotlight
docs.text: Lights up the area in front of it. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Tensor Crystal
docs.text: A crystallized form of raw tensor. Can be harvested with mynamites. Has special conductive properties, depending on the number of adjacent power blocks.

docs.title: Trading Post
docs.text: Sell items for Anucoins. Connect to an Anucoin Node to distribute Anucoins.

docs.title: Unit Shop
docs.text: Buy units using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Vector Crystal
docs.text: A crystallized form of raw vector. Can be harvested with mynamites. Has special conductive properties, depending on the number of adjacent power blocks.

docs.title: Warehouse
docs.text: Stores an extraordinary amount of items of each type. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

docs.title: Color Module
docs.text: Sets the color of adjacent pen blocks. Accepts hex color codes.

docs.title: Cooling Fan
docs.text: Cools down up to 5 adjacent processors with the flow of air, boosting their speed. Consumes a lot of power.

docs.title: Audio Dome
docs.text: Affects the sounds heard by players in range.

docs.title: Heat Sink
docs.text: Cools down up to 2 adjacent processors, boosting their speed.

docs.title: Link Pin
docs.text: Can be linked to a processor to display all of its links, even disabled ones. Invalid links will have a red name, inactive links will have a black square. When pushed by a piston, the linked processor's links will also be shifted.

docs.title: Message Source
docs.text: Outputs random text.

docs.title: Message Void
docs.text: Consumes all message input.

docs.title: Note Block
docs.text: Plays a note when powered or configured by players. config: octave.semitone e.g. 0.00 (C1), 0.01 (C1#), 3.11(B4) color: instrument pitch[[0, 84)

docs.title: Nullifier
docs.text: Controls adjacent buildings, disabling them when powered and enabling them otherwise. Can also disable claws and inertia spinners that are spinning in the air right above it.

docs.title: Pen
docs.text: Draws on the fourth wall when moved. The pen color and stroke can be changed by the corresponding modules.

docs.title: SFX Block
docs.text: Plays a sound effect when powered or configured by players.

docs.title: Note Block Plus
docs.text: Plays a note when powered or configured by players. Notes can be heard throughout the map when powered, which is affected by its volume. config: octave.semitone e.g. 0.00 (C1), 0.01 (C1#), 3.11(B4) color: instrument pitch[[0, 84) volume [[0, 100]

docs.title: Starry Pen
docs.text: Draws on the fourth wall when moved. The pen color and stroke can be changed by the corresponding modules. The ink glows!

docs.title: Stroke Module
docs.text: Sets the stroke of adjacent pen blocks.

docs.title: Waterblock
docs.text: Cools down up to 6 adjacent processors with the high heat capacity of liquids, boosting their speed. Consumes a lot of liquid. The speed boost will vary depending on the type of liquid supplied.

docs.title: Accelerator
docs.text: Outputs power when moved, usually by pistons.

docs.title: Large Button
docs.text: Produces power when clicked. Now easier to tap!

docs.title: Button
docs.text: Produces power when clicked.

docs.title: Large Pressure Plate
docs.text: Produces power when stepped on. Also can detect flying units on top. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Pressure Plate
docs.text: Produces power when stepped on.

docs.title: Button Distributor
docs.text: Produces power when items are inputted. Behaves like a normal distributor...or does it?

docs.title: Button Router
docs.text: Produces power when items are inputted. Behaves like a normal router.

docs.title: Isotope Generator
docs.text: Generates power using exotic radioactive ores.

docs.title: Mega Driller
docs.text: An upgraded version of the mini driller. Drills nearby ores or blocks automatically. Cannot drill items that are too soft.

docs.title: Mini Driller
docs.text: Drills nearby ores or blocks automatically.

docs.title: Large Mynamite
docs.text: Blows up, mining nearby ores and crystals using the force of the explosion. Mined items will be transferred to nearby blocks, excluding conveyors. Better at mining ores, but items that are too soft will be blown away. Provide power to blow it up. It will also blow up automatically when placed on hot floor.

docs.title: Mynamite
docs.text: Blows up, mining nearby ores and crystals using the force of the explosion. Mined items will be transferred to nearby blocks, excluding conveyors. Tap it, or provide power to blow it up. It will also blow up automatically when placed on hot floor.

docs.title: Anchor
docs.text: Fires anchor-shaped piercing shots at naval enemies. Shots travel best on a body of liquid, and will have very limited range otherwise.

docs.title: Astro
docs.text: Fires spikey spheres of void energy, which shoot lightnings at enemies.

docs.title: Backdoor
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Shot bullets are much faster and stronger.

docs.title: Bermuda
docs.text: Fires large anchor-shaped piercing shots at naval enemies. Shots travel best on a body of liquid, and will have very limited range otherwise.

docs.title: Brokerage
docs.text: Fires highly charged anucoins at enemies. Deals heavy damage, but cannot target enemies that are too close.

docs.title: Credit
docs.text: Fires anucoins at enemies. High damage, but also very hard to afford.

docs.title: MasterKey
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Nebula
docs.text: Sprays mid-fusion siloxol mist at enemies. While more damaging than fire, it does not last nor inflict statuses.

docs.title: Payload Cannon
docs.text: Can launch payloads. The higher the health of the payload, and the more blocks it travels, the more damage it deals, but consequently, the more damage the payload itself takes. The payload can be launched safely without damage in the inner range.

docs.title: Payload Catapult
docs.text: Can launch bigger payloads in higher velocities. Devastating news for the enemy.

docs.title: Phisher
docs.text: Hijacks linked 1x1 ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. The range and inaccuracy depends on this turret, not the links. Has boosted reload but slows down hijacked turrets in return. All required coolant is used from this turret in parallel, so make sure to supply enough.

docs.title: Propaganda
docs.text: Fires harmful sound waves at enemies.

docs.title: Ray
docs.text: Focuses an ion beam, which gets stronger over time. Targets only units, and prioritizes foes with high health.

docs.title: Sequence
docs.text: Fires a main sequence star sphere, using hydrogen-rich siloxol as a fusion catalyst and reactant. The stars deal more damage the farther they travel.

docs.title: Spectrum
docs.text: Shoots ionized, accelerated elements at high speed and energy.

docs.title: Spyware
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Shoots hijacked bullets in a spread pattern.

docs.title: Taxation
docs.text: Fires multiple rounds of anucoins at enemies. Deals massive damage both to close-range units and your wallet.

docs.title: Trojan
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Shoots hijacked bullets in a burst pattern.

docs.title: Boost Panel
docs.text: Units on top are accelerated, and applied a speed boost for a short duration.

docs.title: Blue Bumper
docs.text: Units are bounced back in high velocities when they touch this block. Temporarily deflates after bumping an unit.

docs.title: Bumper Plus
docs.text: Units are bounced back in even higher velocities when they touch this block.

docs.title: Bumper
docs.text: Units are bounced back in high velocities when they touch this block.

docs.title: Claw
docs.text: Grabs a nearby unit and tries not to let go. Grabs allies, players and foes alike. Can be controlled by logic or players, in which case it can be controlled to grab blocks or units on non-solid payload blocks, too. Even functions partly on spinners or cogs. Cannot grab other claw blocks or itself.

docs.title: Glass Pipe
docs.text: Made with treated Anuglass, allows bidirectional transport of units, from one end to another. Can output units to payload blocks.

docs.title: Drift Panel
docs.text: Units on top are accelerated, losing control and drifting uncontrollably to the direction the panel faces.

docs.title: Mega Fan
docs.text: Blows stronger wind, pushing units in front. Accepts liquids, which will be sprinkled with the wind. Wind is obstructed by solid blocks. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Fan
docs.text: Blows wind, pushing units in front. Wind is obstructed by solid blocks. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Grand Constructor
docs.text: Fabricates structures up to 6x6 tiles in size. Needs coolant to forge blocks.

docs.title: Small Deconstructor
docs.text: Deconstructs structures and units. Returns 100% of build cost.

docs.title: Disassembler
docs.text: Even bigger version of the deconstructor. Deconstructs structures and units. Returns 100% of build cost.

docs.title: Payload Packer
docs.text: Loads liquids and items into larger blocks.

docs.title: Rail
docs.text: Transports blocks and units. Rail Roombas will pick up a block in front, carry the block, and place it down at its destination.

docs.title: Payload Unpacker
docs.text: Unloads liquids and items into larger blocks.

docs.title: Phase Claw
docs.text: Grabs a nearby unit and tries not to let go. Grabs allies, players and foes alike. This claw needs power to function, except on spinners where it generates its own power from its momentum. Cannot grab other claw blocks or itself.

docs.title: Rail Sorter
docs.text: Distributes blocks and units. Acts as a router when no configuration is selected. Can be configured to sort only blocks, only units, or a specific type of block/unit.

docs.title: Rejuvenator
docs.text: Continuously repairs the closest damaged unit or building in its vicinity. Units are prioritized.

docs.title: Teleporter
docs.text: Teleports players to another teleporter connected to the same power grid. Also teleports ground units. When disabled by logic processors, it only sends players to other teleporters, like a one-way gate.

docs.title: Mini Portal
docs.text: Teleports players to another mini portal. Also teleports ground units.

docs.title: Unit Duct
docs.text: Allows bidirectional transport of units, from one end to another. Only the entrance block needs power to input units. All other blocks do not consume power, even when connected to the grid, so do not worry.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Bedrock[]
docs.text: Used in environmental walls.

docs.title: Bittrium
docs.text: Obtained in Portal Invasions. Used as currency or in ancient inventions.

docs.title: Cryonite
docs.text: Used in freezing weapons and advanced defences.

docs.title: Scalar Ore
docs.text: A natural algebraic material containing a physical quantity of a real number and only that. Can also be described as only having a magnitude.

docs.title: Tensor Ore
docs.text: A natural algebraic object describing a multilinear relationship between sets of algebraic objects related to a vector space, including vector and scalar.

docs.title: Vector Ore
docs.text: A natural algebraic material that has two independent properties, magnitude and direction.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Pixellium[]
docs.text: Used in ancient blocks and floors.

docs.title: Scalar Alloy
docs.text: A refined material processed from scalar ore.

docs.title: Source
docs.text: An algorithm formed by fragments of code storing an amount of information and/or an instruction to run.

docs.title: Space Matter
docs.text: Used in endgame blocks, weapons and antimatter technology.

docs.title: Luminite
docs.text: Used in foreign blocks with special behaviors.

docs.title: Tensor Compound
docs.text: A refined material processed from tensor ore.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Tungsten[]
docs.text: Used in various electrical structures. Heats up and illuminates when under high voltages.

docs.title: Vector Alloy
docs.text: A refined material processed from vector ore.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Wood[]
docs.text: Use unknown.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Zinc[]
docs.text: Used in exotic turrets and high-tier structures.

docs.title: Coffee
docs.text: Somewhat edible programmer fuel.

docs.title: Colloid
docs.text: A high-density coolant with both solid and liquid properties. Used as turret coolant and crafter lubricant.

docs.title: Force Fluid
docs.text: A condensed fluid form of bulletproof force. Used as fuel for advanced bulletproof measures.

docs.title: Siloxol
docs.text: A silicon compound rich in hydrogen. Used as fusion reactant, lubricant, or filtered to obtain water and silicon.

docs.title: [sky]Lunar Colony Ruins[]
docs.text: During the research of the planetary launch systems, a strange signal was received from Serpulo's moon, Shar. Shar was thought as a lifeless moon but patterned radio waves suggest otherwise. Investigate.

docs.title: Amnesia
docs.text: Forgets all abilities.

docs.title: Bane of Resolution
docs.text: It is kill or be killed. Both deal and take infinite damage.

docs.title: Flowery Aura
docs.text: Applies Spring Breeze to nearby ally units.

docs.title: Boosting
docs.text: Fast. Cannot stop.

docs.title: Creative Shock

docs.title: Isolated Conduit
docs.text: A decently fast conduit made from plastanium.

docs.title: Steel Pump
docs.text: A pump made using living steel that uses power to pump great amounts of liquid.

docs.title: Steel Tank
docs.text: A liquid tank made from living steel that has more capacity than a regular liquid tank but the same size.

docs.title: Advanced Solar Panel
docs.text: A better solar panel that takes up the same amount of space as a regular one.

docs.title: Advanced Surge Tower
docs.text: A power node with a lot of range but a max of 2 connections. A better surge tower.

docs.title: Living Steel Thermal Generator
docs.text: Produces heat in hot locations using intelligent spore steel activity. Is more efficient than the normal thermal generator.

docs.title: Power Reserve
docs.text: A HUGE battery capable of storing vast amounts of power.

docs.title: Pyratite Generator
docs.text: Uses the high flammability of pyratite to make a decent amount of power.

docs.title: Reinforced Large Power Node
docs.text: A large power node reinforced using titanium. Is a lot more durable than a regular beam node while also maintaining slightly more range.

docs.title: Reinforced Power Node
docs.text: A power node reinforced using titanium. Is a lot more durable than a regular beam node while also maintaining slightly more range.

docs.title: Slag Generator
docs.text: A generator that uses the heat of Slag to make power.

docs.title: Slag Reactor
docs.text: A reactor that uses the heat of Slag to make power.

docs.title: Solar Array
docs.text: A solar panel with a large surface area, enabling a high energy output.

docs.title: Steam Turbine
docs.text: A better version of the Steam Turbine built using Living Steel. Uses more water in exchange for greatly improved power output. Slowly produces steam and builds up pressure. Explodes when the pressure reaches a critical point.

docs.title: Amalgam Generator
docs.text: Uses the high flammability of Steel Amalgam to create large amounts of power from it.

docs.title: Tiny Thermal Generator
docs.text: Produces power in hot locations.

docs.title: Titanium Solar Panel
docs.text: A better solar panel made with titanium. Produces more power than a regular solar panel.

docs.title: Turbine Concentrator
docs.text: Similar to a Turbine Condenser but creates larger amounts of power and more water.

docs.title: Nuclear Reactor
docs.text: A reactor that uses uraniumrods to create a lot of power. Explodes violently when it is not cooled extensively!

docs.title: Advanced Water Extractor
docs.text: Extracts large quantities of groundwater. Used in locations with no surface water available..

docs.title: Cliff Grinder
docs.text: A faster Cliff Crusher.

docs.title: Cliff Miller
docs.text: A faster Cliff Grinder.

docs.title: Compact Laser Drill
docs.text: Allows small-scale drilling via laser technology, but requires power. Capable of mining thorium.

docs.title: Greenhouse
docs.text: A better cultivator that creates a lot more spore pods.

docs.title: Ground Crusher
docs.text: Quickly grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires large quantities of power.

docs.title: Ground Grinder
docs.text: Slowly grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires power.

docs.title: Ground Miller
docs.text: Grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires a hefty amount of power.

docs.title: Hyper Drill
docs.text: The magnum opus of drill technology. Incapable of mining sand, but mines other ores at massive rates, consuming cryofluid in the process.

docs.title: Mechanical Sieve
docs.text: Slowly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Oil Bore
docs.text: A better oil extractor that runs more efficiently.

docs.title: Pneumatic Sieve
docs.text: Filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Steel Sieve
docs.text: The largest sieve. Rapidly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Tiny Mechanical Drill
docs.text: A tiny version of the mechanical drill.

docs.title: Tiny Plasma Bore
docs.text: A small version of the Plasma Bore.

docs.title: Tiny Pneumatic Drill
docs.text: A tiny version of the pneumatic drill.

docs.title: Titanium Drill
docs.text: A cheap drill for everything.

docs.title: Titanium Sieve
docs.text: Swiftly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Tungsten Bore
docs.text: A Plasma Bore made from Tungsten. Has more range than a normal Plasma Bore.

docs.title: Vent Concentrator
docs.text: A better Vent Condensator that creates more water.

docs.title: Absole
docs.text: Inflicts a high energy burn upon enemies via a highly concentrated laser.

docs.title: Accel
docs.text: Marks a path with a damaging high-precision laser before firing an expanding electric round that explodes on impact.

docs.title: Air Arc
docs.text: Fires arcs of electricity at airborne targets.

docs.title: Batter
docs.text: Shoves back enemies using bolts consisting of various liquids.

docs.title: Arc Storm
docs.text: Swiftly fires powerful arcs of electricity at ground targets.

docs.title: Deracination
docs.text: Beams out an intense tractor beam that pulls in air targets, dealing heavy damage in the process.

docs.title: Shatter
docs.text: Fires various powerful clumps of flak at enemy aircraft.

docs.title: Fragment
docs.text: Damages and destroys incoming projectiles, akin to the segment. Laser projectiles are still not targeted.

docs.title: Assail
docs.text: Launches a flurry of homing missiles at enemies, akin to the swarmer.

docs.title: CAATS
docs.text: Even if the name might sound cute, this is Cerbero's proudest anti-air invention: The Cerberian Anti Air Turret System.

docs.title: Cavalry
docs.text: Launches a rapidly pulsating, cascading plasma orb.

docs.title: Hurricane
docs.text: Fires many clumps of explosive flak at enemies, akin to the cyclone.

docs.title: Diffract
docs.text: Fires high-grade piercing shells that split into more shells.

docs.title: Gattling
docs.text: Pelts nearby enemies with a storm of bullets. Good luck feeding this.

docs.title: Ignitor
docs.text: Fires many close-range piercing bolts at nearby enemies, akin to the fuse.

docs.title: Interitus
docs.text: Deploys a singular homing missile at faraway enemies.

docs.title: Kugelblitz
docs.text: Launches powerful lightning orbs via supercharging of metal.

docs.title: Lightning Chaingun
docs.text: Gradually escalates in firerate, decimating enemies with a flurry of lasers.

docs.title: Armageddon
docs.text: Charges and fires three persistent laser beams at nearby enemies. Requires high quantities of coolant to operate.

docs.title: Landmine Launcher
docs.text: Deploys landmines that stick to the ground for a short while. Mines explode on contact.

docs.title: Missile Battery
docs.text: Deploys ballistic drones that fire a large barrage of homing rockets. Cannot rotate while charging.

docs.title: Nuclear Launch Silo
docs.text: Launches nuclear warheads that disable healing blocks and deal heavy damage to enemies caught in its radius. Low rate of fire.

docs.title: Mortar
docs.text: Flings incendiary cannon shells at nearby enemies. Has a blind spot.

docs.title: Itemslinger
docs.text: Slingshots pieces of raw material at enemies.

docs.title: CBST
docs.text: Cluster bomb strike turret. Fires fragging shells that cover a wide area.

docs.title: Sear
docs.text: Singes nearby enemies, akin to the scorch.

docs.title: Shotgun
docs.text: Fires many rounds at point-blank range. Deals more damage up close.

docs.title: Sniper
docs.text: Long range, high damage. Useful for point defense and securing vulnerable areas.

docs.title: Sprinkler
docs.text: Puts out nearby fires at high efficiency. Not useful in combat, as it deals no damage.

docs.title: Sunflare
docs.text: Incinerates any and all enemies that walk nearby, akin to the sear.

docs.title: Trio
docs.text: Fires rounds utilizing three barrels as opposed to the duo's two.

docs.title: Uhlan
docs.text: Charges and fires three powerful beams of energy at ground targets.

docs.title: Van Turretheim
docs.text: Fires bursts of powerful rounds, akin to a more concentrated shotgun.

docs.title: Weave
docs.text: Fires two weaving shots of water at enemies.

docs.title: Zephyr
docs.text: Fires non-damaging, high-concentration blasts of steam, dealing heavy knockback.

docs.title: Advanced Reassembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units to the 3rd tier. These upgraded units may be upgraded a final time.

docs.title: Basic Reassembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units created in the Basic Factory to the next tier. Units produced by this Reassembly Chamber may be further upgraded.

docs.title: Primary Factory
docs.text: Creates small and light units which may be upgraded using Reassembly Chambers.

docs.title: Progressive Assembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units to the 4th and final tier.

docs.title: Regenerator
docs.text: A tower that continuously heals all allied units in its range. Requires Cryofluid.

docs.title: Copper Ammo
docs.text: Simple, boring ammo with absolutly no effects whatsoever.

docs.title: Titanium Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from titanium. Decent damage and has pierce.

docs.title: Explosive Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from blast compound. Decent damage and has a frag effect in some turrets.

docs.title: Cryogenic Alloy
docs.text: A shock-cooled, highly durable metal made from Igneous Alloy, Cryogenic Gel and Neutron Fluid. Useful in advanced electronic components.

docs.title: Cryogenic Gel
docs.text: A very cold material made from mixing cryofluid and silicon. Used as one of the components to create Cryogenic Alloy.

docs.title: Fuel Rod
docs.text: A fuel rod constructed from layering thorium on a durable plastanium and lead core.

docs.title: Gold
docs.text: A shiny piece of metal! Can be traded to get other resources.

docs.title: Healing Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from spore pods. No damage but heals hit allied blocks.

docs.title: Homing Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from thorium. Good damage and has a homing effect.

docs.title: Igneous Alloy
docs.text: A very hot material smelted from surge alloy and titanium using slag. Used as a component needed to create Cryogenic Alloy.

docs.title: Hardened Living Steel
docs.text: Living steel that was infused with thorium to make it more durable.

docs.title: Living Steel
docs.text: A living piece of metal. Titanium infused with spores.

docs.title: Nano Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from living steel that infects enemies with nano bots which burn them from the inside.

docs.title: Nuke
docs.text: A nuclear warhead made using graphite and fuel rods.

docs.title: Steel Amalgam
docs.text: A compound material made from Copper, Living Steel and Surge Alloy.

docs.title: Acid
docs.text: A dangerous liquid.

docs.title: Living Steel Liquid
docs.text: Living Steel that was infused with oil thus making it a liquid. Spreads to nearby oil to 'self-replicate'.

docs.title: Neutron Fluid
docs.text: A highly potent coolant created by mixing oil, cryofluid and living steel liquid.

docs.title: Steam
docs.text: Evaporated water.

docs.title: Cangirus
docs.text: A lush planet that has land and water.

docs.title: Cerbero
docs.text: A barren planet where tragedy struck long ago. Nothing is left here besides destruction and death.

docs.title: Hathor
docs.text: A small piece of Cerbero created by the impact of a meteor. Nothing lasts here except an ancient Cerberian base built here before everything collapsed...

docs.title: Abandoned Battlefield
docs.text: The last sector before you conquer Cerbero. The instruments register many powerful foes here. Waves will be sent relentlessly. Try to survive!

docs.title: Dree
docs.text: The next step on your journey through Cerbero. This sector has coal and water. Use coal to create primitive power. Upgrade your resources.

docs.title: Etnatic Isles
docs.text: The Crux's primary manufacturing plant for flammables and circuitry. Eliminate the outposts, bust through the main gate and secure valuable resources.

docs.title: Exordium
docs.text: You arrive on Cerbero. This is the sector that the computer calculated the least danger for. Start your journey. Set up basic operations. Prepare for more difficult sectors.

docs.title: Spore Dunes
docs.text: The next challenging sector on cerbero. Has Titanium. Harder waves.

docs.title: [orange]Aedes
docs.text: Shoots swerving bullets at nearby targets. Rotors deal damage.

docs.title: [orange]Apis
docs.text: Fires small yet deadly precision laser blasts. Can hover.

docs.title: [orange]Armiger
docs.text: Equipped with rocket launchers and a minigun. Rotor deals decent damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: Penumbra
docs.text: A unit with technology similar to that of the Serpulo Antumbra but the main cannons shoot a laser instead of regular bullets.

docs.title: Veil
docs.text: Like the Eclipse unit but instead of shooting flak bullets, it shoots energy missiles. Also shoots stronger lasers. Sacrifices some of it's armor for more health and damage.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: A unit similar to a Flare from Serpulo but with upgraded weaponry.

docs.title: Vista
docs.text: A Horizon-like unit that throws down stronger bombs.

docs.title: Summit
docs.text: A unit similar to a Zenith but the missile launchers fire barrages of missiles instead of single ones.

docs.title: [orange]Alopex
docs.text: Fires concentrated piercing lasers at nearby targets. Quick, but frail.

docs.title: [orange]Culiseta
docs.text: Equipped with fragging bombs, targetable missiles, railguns, and more. Manufactures assault and siege units on board to deploy upon destruction. Rotor deals damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: [yellow]Delta
docs.text: Defends the Atom core from enemies. Swiftly builds structures, and is equipped with healing beams.

docs.title: [yellow]Epsilon
docs.text: Defends the Element core from enemies. Rapidly builds a variety of structures, and is equipped with multiple healing beams.

docs.title: [purple]HIVE Heavy Assault Unit (HHAU)
docs.text: Equipped a high-velocity missile launcher.

docs.title: [orange]HIVE
docs.text: Frail, but has a powerful forcefield, alongside assault unit constructors. Boasts many highly effective laser weapons.

docs.title: [orange]Kestrel
docs.text: Equipped with onboard arc turrets and a concentrated laser beam. Forfeits agility and speed for power.

docs.title: [orange]Areus
docs.text: Fires a miniaturized laser beam at nearby targets.

docs.title: [orange]Onirion
docs.text: Equipped with a torpedo cannon, dual missile launchers, and swerving machine guns. Additionally, drops bombs on targets underneath it. Rotors deal large damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: [green]Sapling
docs.text: Capable of large-scale mining, building, and repairing. The penultimate support drone.

docs.title: [green]Sprout
docs.text: Capable of automatic mining, building, and repairing. Boosts nearby allied units' move speed.

docs.title: [green]Seed
docs.text: Capable of automatic mining, repairing, and building.

docs.title: [orange]Orbital Platform Strahl
docs.text: Boasts many highly concentrated laser beams, alongside point defense beam turrets. Rapidly builds and releases Alopex.

docs.title: [purple]Annax
docs.text: Deals medium-high damage via twin slag guns. Effective against enemy transport structures.

docs.title: Auctus
docs.text: A long, snake-like unit that stomps buildings.

docs.title: [purple]Auratus
docs.text: Utilizes slag and water orbs to neutralize enemy targets. Additionally, it is equipped with a main railcannon.

docs.title: Curtulus
docs.text: A unit with an appearance close to that of an Arkyid but instead of the main cannon shooting artillery bullets, it shoots a liquid shell.

docs.title: Hexathelid
docs.text: A unit type similar to an Atrax but shoots fragging slag bullets. Exchanges less health and armor for a lot more damage.

docs.title: Cerberian Behemoth
docs.text: A huge unit and Cerberos proudest invention. Shoots with a ginormous laser, huge fragging bullets, laser sweepers and smaller FLAK turrets.

docs.title: Straggle
docs.text: A cerberian version of the Crawler unit.

docs.title: Bayonet
docs.text: A stronger version of the Dagger unit typically found on Serpulo.

docs.title: Citadel
docs.text: An upgraded version of the Fortress that hails from Cerbero.

docs.title: Cudgel
docs.text: A unit similar to a Mace from Serpulo but stronger. Shoots with a different type of Flamethrower.

docs.title: Kaiser
docs.text: A unit inspired by the Reign from Serpulo but with upgraded technology. Hass massively increased health and armor at the cost of sacrificing some agility.

docs.title: Baton
docs.text: A re-manufactured version of the Scepter unit.

docs.title: Nephila
docs.text: Like the Spiroct unit but steals more life using enhanced sapping lasers.

docs.title: Setosus
docs.text: A Toxopid-like unit. The secondary cannons shoot out sapping lasers instead of normal ones. Equipped with significantly more armor and attack power than a regular Toxopid.

docs.title: [green]Corax
docs.text: Charges up a gigawatt laser that obliterates enemy structures and units alike. Additionally equipped with smaller artillery lasers.

docs.title: [purple]Reduct
docs.text: Freezes its targets alive via a frigid laser.

docs.title: [orange]Ducalis
docs.text: Equipped with rocket and proximity mine launchers. Powerful in sieges.

docs.title: [purple]Toruct
docs.text: Lights targets ablaze with a small, fiery laser.

docs.title: [orange]Onager
docs.text: Equipped with a homing rocket cannon and several smaller weapons. Obliterates all buildings in its path, but suffers against units. Can run over enemy structures.

docs.title: [orange]Procer
docs.text: Rapid-fires dual salvos of missiles at enemy targets. Is also equipped with a piercing laser.

docs.title: [orange]Sambuca
docs.text: Fires standard bullets at enemy structures. Less effective against units.

docs.title: [purple]Scofra
docs.text: Equipped with dual oil and slag guns. Can walk over walls and terrain.

docs.title: [orange]Scorpio
docs.text: Equipped with a railgun that pierces most laser-blocking defenses. Less effective against units.

docs.title: [orange]Springald
docs.text: Equipped with a rocket launching cannon and small laser arrays. Excels at siege against buildings, but is weaker against units.

docs.title: [purple]Lycosid
docs.text: Equipped with elemental cannons. Constructs and deploys Toructs and Reducts.

docs.title: [green]Aestiva
docs.text: Equipped with a shotgun capable of healing allied structures. Manufactures Albas on board.

docs.title: [green]Alba
docs.text: Equipped with a small regeneration projector, but no weapons.

docs.title: [green]Altaic
docs.text: Equipped with multiple healing and point defense weapons. Deploys Oxynoe. Damages and slows down enemies via an energy field, which additionally heals nearby allied units and structures.

docs.title: [orange]Arnux
docs.text: Launches a powerful plasma sphere at faraway targets. Also equipped with triple laser burst turrets.

docs.title: [green]Arvens
docs.text: Equipped with a healing mend projector. Boosts nearby allied units' build speed.

docs.title: [orange]Cromis
docs.text: Fires trios of missiles. Additionally, is equipped with a laser that inflicts EMP on hit targets.

docs.title: [orange]Japonica
docs.text: Boasts a homing missile launcher, several persistent laser beams, and numerous autocannons. Manufactures and deploys Rissos out to sea.

docs.title: [orange]Mela
docs.text: Swiftly fires cannon shells at nearby targets. Equipped with a mine launcher.
