docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/zielonytrojkat/frozen-farlands Stars 91 Last updated 2026-06-10T18:35:51Z

Before you'll play this mod, let me tell you that skill and patience are highly required.

You need to learn from your mistakes and lost battles in order to complete some sectors.

Welcome to the Frozen farlands,

here, where there is no such thing called heat, Serpulo's Moon Awaits you!

Zilo, a place colonized by Bushark the fraction from Tantros,

Even if that's only a moon there are many new things, new resources, blocks, units, turrets, just everything.

There is one more place we would like you to visit... Gheţar

A Lonely Asteroid orbiting behind Zilo,

Maybe it's a small place but it doesn't means it is going to be easy in there, but surely you'd be having fun...

This mod contains custom soundtracks, please do not steal them... instead get a better vibe while playing

And Thanks to Świrek for helping us with code.

We hope you'll enjoy our mod

This Isn't our last creation, we have a huge plans upcoming, if you are interested in our plans, concepts and updates join our discord server

Our contributtors: RouterXdd, Silin Veredno and Catana8735

link: https://discord.gg/TQTW3mfYyf

We also have it on a disboard.

docs.title: Cryothermal Generator
docs.text: Mixes heat from Arcalith with cold Cryogenium to create power, produces water as byproduct.

docs.title: Ionized Xenon Generator
docs.text: Produces large amounts of energy using Ionized Xenon.

docs.title: Large Solar
docs.text: Larger wersion of the Solar, produces more power.

docs.title: Electric Tower
docs.text: Only has two connections but increased range.

docs.title: Large Electric Node
docs.text: Larger power node, has more available connections.

docs.title: Electric Node
docs.text: Small Power Node

docs.title: Solar
docs.text: Produces power from the sun.

docs.title: Bauxite Crusher
docs.text: A drill designed for mining Bauxite.

docs.title: Ice Crusher
docs.text: A drill designed for harvesting Ice.

docs.title: Micro Drill
docs.text: A small and cheap drill, effective in larger amounts.

docs.title: Ray Drill
docs.text: Mines even faster using fragmental technology, can be accelerated by Xenon. Requires power.

docs.title: Sickle Drill
docs.text: Mines faster using sharp blades.

docs.title: Alectro
docs.text: A powerful turret that is perfect for taking down hoards of enemies from a large distance.

docs.title: Defragmentation
docs.text: Shoots a medium-ranged piercing laser that splits enemies from the inside.

docs.title: Dragonfly
docs.text: Fires a hail of bullets at enemies.

docs.title: Frostbite
docs.text: Absolutley devastates enemies with its powerful, extremly cold fragmentational beam.

docs.title: Leech
docs.text: Deals constant damage to a single target using a medium-ranged laser.

docs.title: Moonray
docs.text: Charges up to fire a single piercing bullet.

docs.title: Pike
docs.text: A small turret, good for taking down single targets.

docs.title: Restart
docs.text: A fragmentational superweapon, capable of dealing with enemies with ease.

docs.title: Stinger
docs.text: Hits enemies with a single spiked bullet.

docs.title: Stormer
docs.text: Long-ranged missile launcher, can use various materials to shoot different types of rockets.

docs.title: Tide
docs.text: A simple medium-ranged liquid turret.

docs.title: Zap
docs.text: A small turret capable of dealing serious damage and stunning enemies.

docs.title: Icycle
docs.text: Medium ranged turret that targets enemy bullets.

docs.title: Pin
docs.text: Shoots single Yttrium bullets at enemies.

docs.title: Mech Assembler
docs.text: Using drones, creates tier 4 Mechs.

docs.title: Spider-Mech Assembler
docs.text: Using drones, creates tier 4 Spider-Mechs.

docs.title: Flying Units Assembler
docs.text: Using drones, creates tier 4 Flying units.

docs.title: Support Assembler
docs.text: Using drones, creates tier 4 support units..

docs.title: Assembler Module
docs.text: "Allows for 5 tier units upgrades. Place next to an Assemblers' bounding box."

docs.title: Mech Constructor
docs.text: Fabricates basic ground units.

docs.title: Spider-Mech Constructor
docs.text: Fabricates spider-shaped units.

docs.title: Flying Units Constructor
docs.text: Fabricates flying units.

docs.title: Support Constructor
docs.text: Fabricates support units.

docs.title: Mech Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades Mechs to their next tier.

docs.title: Spider-Mech Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades Spider-Mechs their next tier.

docs.title: Flying Units Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades flying units their next tier.

docs.title: Support Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades support units their next tier.

docs.title: Main Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades all kinds of units to tier 3.

docs.title: Payload Fabricator
docs.text: Fabricates 2x2 blocks.

docs.title: Unit Mender
docs.text: Repairs units using only power

docs.title: Yttrium Payload Bridge
docs.text: Redirects payload, has built-in sorter.

docs.title: Yttrium Payload Conveyor
docs.text: Transports payload, limited to payloads of a 3x3 size.

docs.title: Aerogel
docs.text: Very light material with average durability, used for producing flying units.

docs.title: Aluminium
docs.text: A metal created through smelting Bauxite, used in more advanced buildings.

docs.title: Arcanite
docs.text: A material with energetic properties, can be used in all power-related buildings.

docs.title: Arcanthium
docs.text: A material made from combining and compressing Arcanite with other materials. Extremly energetically active.

docs.title: Bauxite
docs.text: This material can be smelted into Aluminium.

docs.title: Cryogenium
docs.text: A very cold material that can be extracted from cryofluid.

docs.title: Diamond
docs.text: Very durable material, can be used in buildings or as ammo.

docs.title: Ice Shards
docs.text: Frozen water...

docs.title: Moonstone
docs.text: A stone used in more advanced technology.

docs.title: Reinforced Cryofabric
docs.text: An extremly durable material capable of absorbing many kinetic or energetic forces before taking damage.

docs.title: Yttrium
docs.text: A very common material on Zilo, used in nearly all buildings.

docs.title: Arcalith
docs.text: A warm fluid extracted from Arcanite.

docs.title: Ionized Xenon
docs.text: Charged particles of Xenon, can be used as energy source.

docs.title: Xenon
docs.text: Abnormaly common on Zilo, Can be extracted from air. Used in production.

docs.title: CrashLanding
docs.text: A land devastated by a spaceship that crashed here, maybe we can find new technology?

docs.title: Cryo River
docs.text: A river of Cryofluid with remnants of an old enemy base. Capture it to push back our enemies.

docs.title: The Fortress
docs.text: The greatest base that Bushark has ever built. Many attacks were already launched here, none of which were successful. They have an unimaginably powerful super weapon guarding their main entrance, this base is extremly guarded. The more time you spend defending, the harder it gets. Your base will be constantly attacked, you have to launch succesful counter attacks in order to survive. If you manage to capture this base, the whole of Zilo will be under our control.

docs.title: Frontline
docs.text: We are preparing for our final target, main base of Bushark on Zilo, also known as The Fortress, they already know our plans and they are throwing everything at us, if you will be able to defend yourself, we can launch an attack on The Fortress.

docs.title: Ground Sub Zero
docs.text: The perfect place for your first steps on Zilo, collect new materials, research new technology and destroy the enemy outpost nearby.

docs.title: Lonely Lake
docs.text: A öake of cryofluid located around mountains, Maybe we can use it to research new technologies?

docs.title: Secret Passage
docs.text: Our next primary target is another enemy base located along the sunny mountains, sadly the terrain does not allows us to attack it straight up, we have to get through this claustrophobic ravine...

docs.title: Solar Peaks
docs.text: One of 2 main bases of Bushark on Zilo, their technology far surpasses yours but there is no turning back now, eradicate everything and steal their technology.

docs.title: The Asylum
docs.text: A vast place located on an asteroid. Here, Bushark from Zilo has teamed up with the Crux from Serpulo to get revenge on you. Once you defeat them, the whole asteroid will be under your control. These two factions will not give you an easy victory, you have really made them mad...

docs.title: Transit Cavern
docs.text: A cave used for transporting resources and goods, we have to weaken our enemies. Take over this place and eradicate every enemy in your path.

docs.title: Quark
docs.text: Shoots with single energy bullet, can heal friendly structures and mine, can heal allies.

docs.title: Proton
docs.text: Can help with building and repairing, has stronger bullets, can heal allies and mine.

docs.title: Neutron
docs.text: builds faster and can mine, has two guns, can heal allies.

docs.title: Element
docs.text: Charges us a strong piercing laser, can repair frendly structures and heal allies.

docs.title: Quantum
docs.text: Shoots with series of 10 powerful energy bullets, cannot heal alies but has a shield instead.

docs.title: Stellar
docs.text: Guards the Glacier core; deals less damage against buildings.

docs.title: Polaris
docs.text: Guards the Iceberg core; deals less damage against buildings.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: Shoots basic energy bullets.

docs.title: Bolt
docs.text: Shoots larger and stronger bullets.

docs.title: Flicker
docs.text: Fires a pirecing laser, gets knocked back after shooting.

docs.title: Lightning
docs.text: Fires two massive bullets, also equipped with two smaller turrets.

docs.title: Thunderstorm
docs.text: Equipped with two missile launchers and two altillery cannons, very tough.

docs.title: Sullivbane Laserking
docs.text: LETS GET FUCKIN LOOOOOOOOOOOUUUD!!!

docs.title: Salmon
docs.text: Small and cheap unit used for transporting resources.

docs.title: Blade
docs.text: Equipped with two repeater yttrium guns.

docs.title: Scimitar
docs.text: Equipped with two more powerful burst yttrium guns.

docs.title: Rapier
docs.text: Equipped with two long ranged yttrium guns.

docs.title: Cutlass
docs.text: Equipped with two even more long ranged yttrium guns.

docs.title: Decimate
docs.text: Equipped with two bomb launchers, very tough.

docs.title: Claw
docs.text: Shoots small cryo rockets.

docs.title: Sight
docs.text: Uses a small beam to steal life from enemies.

docs.title: Bite
docs.text: Shoots triple bullets.

docs.title: Devour
docs.text: devastates everything with his large beam.

docs.title: Predator
docs.text: Has two lasers and one long-ranged bomb launcher, also equipped with star-shaped shield.

docs.title: Freezer
docs.text: Makes snow from water.

docs.title: Heater
docs.text: Melts snowballs into water.

docs.title: Tainter

docs.title: reWall

docs.title: Collector
docs.text: Extracts scrap from dead units

docs.title: Thorns
docs.text: Damages all units walking on them.

docs.text: Primitive power generator. Efficiency depends on amount of solid blocks around.

docs.title: Multi Drill

docs.title: Scraper

docs.title: Hacker
docs.text: Captures enemy units. Hacking speed depends on max health.

docs.title: Shredder
docs.text: Small turret made out of scrap.

docs.title: Snowball

docs.title: Blast Workshop
docs.text: The flammable structure of creostone, with the addition of oil with a catalyst, can become a good substitute for blast compounds.

docs.title: Big Dense Smelter
docs.text: A more advanced smelter that uses the blast power of an explosion to increase pressure. It is produced by slag as a by-product.

docs.title: Creostone Crucible
docs.text: With help of creotine, melts silicon into creostone.

docs.title: Creostone Smelter
docs.text: Melts silicon and mixes it with creotite, producing creostone.

docs.title: Creotite Converter
docs.text: Melts silicon and mixes it with creotite, producing creostone. It is produced by metal as a by-product.

docs.title: Creotite Megamixer
docs.text: Updated technologies allow you to get creotite from ledonite, but for this you will have to make a quick temperature jump.

docs.title: Creotite Mixer
docs.text: Melts several thorium isotopes. The molten mass is diluted with cryofluid and does not allow to solidify, then adding powdered pyratite to the mass and heats it up to high temperatures, obtaining creotite.

docs.title: Cryochamber
docs.text: Converts cryofluid into a solid aggregation state. Increases efficiency in moisture areas.

docs.title: Cryofluid Megamixer
docs.text: Mixes water and fine titanium powder, adding ice cubes, producing cryofluid.

docs.title: Dense Smelter
docs.text: Melts copper and lead, producing a dense alloy.

docs.title: Diamond Press
docs.text: Under the influence of high pressure, the carbon compounds transform their crystal lattice to form a diamond.

docs.title: Electromixer
docs.text: Melts surge alloy using slag, obtaining a charged surge mass.

docs.title: Freezer
docs.text: Freezes water obtaining ice.

docs.title: Globium Smelter
docs.text: Melts lead, titanium and thorium, producing globium.

docs.title: Hypercharge Transformer
docs.text: Brings a stone to a hypercharged state using surge mass.

docs.title: Pulse Surge Smelter
docs.text: An improved version of the surge alloy foundry. Uses creotite to increase production efficiency.

docs.title: Glaciation Chamber
docs.text: Transforms Ledonite into its solid aggregation state. Optionally uses ice cubes. Increases efficiency in moisture areas.

docs.title: Ledonite Mixer
docs.text: Mixes cryofluid and fine titanium powder together with ice cubes, producing ledonite.

docs.title: Average Charger
docs.text: Uses surge mass to convert graphite into rods with a significant amount of charge. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Mighty Charger
docs.text: Uses surge mass to transform titanium pieces into supercharged ingots. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Multicharger
docs.text: It is capable of producing charged wiring using surge mass and a specific resource for a specific wiring.

docs.title: Neoplasm Converter
docs.text: Converts neoplasm and slag into creotine.

docs.title: Neoplasm Furnace
docs.text: Combines tungsten and surge alloy into a carved alloy. Requires argon and heat to work. Produces a huge amount of neoplasm as a byproduct. Explodes violently of neoplasm is not removed from the furnace via conduits.

docs.title: Phase Sewing Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes phase fabric from tinorium and sand. Requires ledonite liquid to work.

docs.title: Plastanium Press
docs.text: It produces plastanium from globium and oil. Uses a blast compound to increase the intensity of production. It is most effective in oil fields.

docs.title: Sapphire Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes tungsten into sapphire. Requires heat to work.

docs.title: Solidification Chamber
docs.text: Cools the slag with water, forming a rocky breed.

docs.title: Surge Mass Synthesizer
docs.text: Melts surge alloy using slag, obtaining a charged surge mass. Uses scrap to melt into slag, which concentrates its amount, increasing production efficiency.

docs.title: Tinorium Crystallizer
docs.text: Crystallizes isotopes of carbon and thorium into a massive radioactive substance «Tinorium».

docs.title: Weak Charger
docs.text: Uses surge mass to convert lead into a charged form. Light wire kind. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Armed Creostone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Burns all enemies nearby when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Cryo Cube Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Shoots clots of cryofluid at enemy targets when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Graphite Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Shoots a piercing laser when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Ice Cube
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Fires at enemies with ice spikes when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Silicon Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Fires a homing missiles at enemy targets when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Stone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Continuously shoots piercing bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Armed Surge Stone wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Shoots an explosive shock sphere at enemy targets when power is provided.

docs.title: Carved Monolith
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Heals when damaged. Periodically releases 6 piercing blasts around itself upon contact.

docs.title: Large Carved Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Heals when damaged.

docs.title: Carved Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Heals when damaged.

docs.title: Charged Lead Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Provides power from sun. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Huge Creostone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Protects a small area around itself with a shield when power is provided.

docs.title: Creostone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Increases the speed of nearby buildings when power is provided.

docs.title: Cryo Cube Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Freezes all enemies nearby when power is provided.

docs.title: Large Dense Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Armored. Deflect most of enemy bullets.

docs.title: Dense Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Armored.

docs.title: Large Emerald Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Periodically releases upon contact laser bolts that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures.

docs.title: Emerald Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Periodically releases upon contact laser bolts that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures.

docs.title: Large Globium Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Unfolds a square shield that absorbs enemy projectiles when power is provided. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Globium Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Unfolds a square shield that absorbs enemy projectiles when power is provided. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Graphite Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Repairs blocks in its vicinity at high speed when power is provided.

docs.title: Ice Cube Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Absorbs enemy lasers.

docs.title: Reinforced Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Blocks automatic power connections. Absorbs enemy lasers and electric arcs. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Large Ruby Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Throws away the shards with Bloodrage virus after losing a certain amount of health.

docs.title: Ruby Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Throws away the shards with Bloodrage virus after losing a certain amount of health.

docs.title: Large Sapphire Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections.

docs.title: Sapphire Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections.

docs.title: Silicon Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles.

docs.title: Stone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles.

docs.title: Surge Stone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Compact Mass Driver
docs.text: Collects items in a small capsule and shoots it at other compact mass drivers.

docs.title: Creostone Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: It moves items over terrain for longer distances than conventional bridge conveyor.

docs.title: Creostone Conveyor
docs.text: Moves items forward. Faster and stronger than titanium conveyor.

docs.title: Creostone Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for two intersecting conveyor belts.

docs.title: Creostone Router
docs.text: Evenly distributes incoming items in 3 output directions.

docs.title: Globium Conveyor
docs.text: Moves items forward at the same speed as the creostone conveyor, but does not accept non-conveyor inputs to the sides.

docs.title: Globium Stack Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward in bundles, accommodates up to 25 items.

docs.title: Strong Conveyor
docs.text: Moves items forward. Faster than a standard conveyor, but slower than a titanium one. Has a large amount of health.

docs.title: Strong Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for two intersecting conveyor belts. Stronger than a standard junction.

docs.title: Strong Router
docs.text: Evenly distributes incoming items in 3 output directions. Stronger than a standard router.

docs.title: Teleporter
docs.text: Technology for instant movement of items. Transports items from one teleporter to another.

docs.title: Armored Container
docs.text: Stores a small number of items of each type. Items can be removed using an unloader. Well fortified.

docs.title: Armored Storage
docs.text: Stores a large number of items of each type. Items can be removed using an unloader. Well fortified.

docs.title: Core: Cage
docs.text: Core of the base. It is more heavily armored than all previous iterations. It stores more items than Nucleus. Provides power.

docs.title: Core: Energon
docs.text: Core of the base. Heavily armored. Stores the largest amount of resources. Fires charged shells at enemy targets. Periodically releases a piercing blasts upon contact. Equipped with an energy field. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Core: Ocean
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Core: Purple Night
docs.text: Core of the base. Very well armored. Stores a large number of items. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Core: Triumph
docs.text: Core of the base. Stores items.

docs.title: Core: Victory
docs.text: Core of the base. Stores items. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Creostone Mine
docs.text: Explodes upon contact with an enemy unit.

docs.title: Creostone Storage
docs.text: Stores items. Very durable.

docs.title: Crystal Accelerator
docs.text: Increases the speed of nearby buildings. Requires phase fabric and ruby to operate. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Emerald Core
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Energy Field Projector
docs.text: Hits enemy targets with electric arcs in a radius. Produces «Thunderbolt» units.

docs.title: Energy Field Projector
docs.text: Stuns all enemies trapped in the radius of the energy field.

docs.title: Flashlight
docs.text: Emits bright light over a large radius.

docs.title: Indigo Barrier
docs.text: Unfolds an octagonal shield protecting buildings and units from enemy projectiles. Overheats when receiving a large amount of damage. Optionally uses coolant to prevent overheating. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Sapphire Restorer
docs.text: Repairs blocks in its vicinity. Optionally uses phase fabric to boost range and efficiency. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Scarlet Gem
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Core: Snow Monolith
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Core: Tesla
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored. Generates a small amount of power. Heals if damaged. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Armored Liquid Container
docs.text: Stores a small amount of liquid. It outputs liquids in all directions, like a liquid router. Well fortified.

docs.title: Armored Liquid Tank
docs.text: Stores a large amount of liquid. It outputs liquids in all directions, like a liquid router. Well fortified.

docs.title: Creostone Bridge Conduit
docs.text: It moves liquids over the terrain for longer distances than a standard bridge conduit.

docs.title: Creostone Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids forward. Faster, stronger and accommodates more than a pulse conduit.

docs.title: Creostone Liquid Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge between two crossing conduits.

docs.title: Creostone Liquid Router
docs.text: Accepts liquids from one direction and distributes them evenly to 3 others. It can also store a certain amount of liquid. It is possible to build on deep water. Has a large amount of health.

docs.title: Globium Conduit
docs.text: Designed for high-speed movement of a large amount of liquid.

docs.title: Strong Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids forward. It works faster and accommodates more than a standard conduit, but less than pulse one.

docs.title: Topaz Bridge Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids over any terrain or buildings. Has a smaller capacity and greater strength than a reinforced bridge conduit. Distributes the liquid output evenly to the sides. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Topaz Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids forward. Faster, stronger, and accommodates more than reinforced conduit. Accepts input/output from the sides. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Topaz Liquid Junction
docs.text: Acts as a junction for two intersecting conduits. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Topaz Liquid Router
docs.text: Distributes liquids evenly in all directions. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Upgraded Pump
docs.text: Pumps and removes liquids.

docs.title: Charge Reactor
docs.text: Accelerates, generating a huge amount of power using a charge of surge mass. The stronger the acceleration, the more power is generated. It will explode with great power with sufficient damage. Uses ice cubes for cooling.

docs.title: Copper Transformer
docs.text: Transforms copper into power particles.

docs.title: Creostone Battery
docs.text: Accumulates power in times of its excess. Removes power in times of scarcity. Stores a significantly large amount of power, has quite a few health units.

docs.title: Creostone Beam Node
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally. Stores a decent amount of power.

docs.title: Creostone Beam Tower
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally. Stores a huge amount of power. Larger distance of transmission.

docs.title: Large Creostone Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Larger distance of transmission.

docs.title: Creostone Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Transmission distance is greater than the usual power node.

docs.title: Creostone Power Tower
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Very large transmission distance, fewer connections.

docs.title: Creostone Reactor
docs.text: Generates significant amounts of power from creostone. Requires constant cooling. Will explode violently if insufficient amounts of coolant are supplied.

docs.title: Creostone Solar Panel
docs.text: Provides power from sun and wind.

docs.title: Creotine Combustion Chamber
docs.text: Uses creostone and creotine to generate power. Requires placement on the vents.

docs.title: Hidden Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Hidden from enemy attacks.

docs.title: Hydrogenerator
docs.text: Generates power when placed in wet places.

docs.title: Matter Collapser
docs.text: A reactor operating with a cost of each resources and liquids temperature. Higher items cost and liquids temperature, the higher power generation. Requires a lot of time to accelerate to max power generation. Due to the very high voltage, the reactor emits electric arcs, which damages reactor and can lead to an explosion. To prevent an explosion, reactor needs constant monitoring, repair, and isolation from nearby buildings. Will explode with great power upon destruction.

docs.title: Mineralizer
docs.text: Accelerates amethyst particles using ozone to generate a considerable amount of power. Get damaged in the process, needs constant repair. Will explode with great power when destroyed.

docs.title: Oil Transformer
docs.text: Generates power when placed in oil-containing places.

docs.title: Rift Borehole
docs.text: Generates power when placed on gas rifts. Produces a small amount of argon.

docs.title: Ruby Cleaver
docs.text: Splits ruby to an atomic state, generating a large amount of power. Uses argon as a stabilizer.

docs.title: Medium Solar Panel
docs.text: Provides power from the sun.

docs.title: Spore Generator
docs.text: Generates power when placed in spore-containing areas.

docs.title: Strong Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Stronger than a large power node, but the transmission distance is smaller.

docs.title: Argon Borehole
docs.text: Extracts argon from the rifts and place it to a gas tank.

docs.title: Incandescent Drill
docs.text: A special drill for extracting pieces of creostone. It is also capable of extracting ordinary ore. Uses the heat of the creotite as an accelerator.

docs.title: Emerald Extractor
docs.text: Extracts emerald from the ground. Requires cryofluid and cryo cube for extraction.

docs.title: Light Drilling Rig
docs.text: Has a built-in light plant, which, from the absorption of electromagnetic waves, accelerates to a tremendous speed, extracting a huge amount of resources. Uses ledonite liquid as a mandatory component for cooling.

docs.title: Lightning Drill
docs.text: Mines ore. It requires a fairly large amount of power. Optionally uses ledonite for coolant.

docs.title: Oil Pump
docs.text: Pumps oil out of the ground, improves efficiency in oil fields.

docs.title: Ruby Drill
docs.text: A new type of drill, capable of synthesizing rubies under impacts, requires flow cooling and fuel for operation.

docs.title: Sand Mine
docs.text: Drills and extracts sand from the ground. Requires water to work.

docs.title: Small Drill
docs.text: When placed on ore, outputs items at a slow pace indefinitely. Only capable of mining basic resources. Does not require cooling.

docs.title: Spore Extractor
docs.text: Grows tiny concentrations of atmospheric spores into spore pods. Uses ice cubes to increase the efficiency of cultivation.

docs.title: Thorium Mine
docs.text: The explosion extracts thorium from the ground, using a blast compound as an explosion reactor. Uses cryofluid for cooling.

docs.title: Titanium Extractor
docs.text: Extracts titanium from the ground. Requires water for extraction.

docs.title: Topaz Mine
docs.text: Extracts topaz from underground along with impurities in the form of sand and beryllium. Requires placement on topaz veins, and argon for operation.

docs.title: Abyss
docs.text: Sapping and damages all enemy targets. Spawns auxiliary creatures. Bigger target - higher damage. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Addiction
docs.text: Fires a burst of piercing projectiles, unmoving all enemies in a row with a laser. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Adynamia
docs.text: Fires a charged thorium or tinonium laser bullets. Spawns an Absorbtion unit, protecting it self with an arc shield. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Aorta
docs.text: Opens and fires an exploding sphere, next releasing a huge accumulation of shells of various types, causing huge damage to enemy targets. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Bloodlust
docs.text: Fires a large ruby bolts over long distances. Fires a bloody beams at enemy targets, repairing itself in the process. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Bow
docs.text: Fires a homing piercing arrows at enemy aircraft. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Brazier
docs.text: Transforms power into a beam charge containing particles of gold dust, and burns out all enemies that fall under its action. Transforms surge mass into energy clumps, directing them along the beam and causing additional damage to enemy targets. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Fires a piercing bullets at enemies. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Cloud Breaker
docs.text: Fires an explosive shells at enemy targets. Commits fire punch at enemy targets in radius, spawning creatures named glaive of fire. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Corroding
docs.text: Fires a burst of acid homing shells at enemy targets. Pierce enemy sheilds and armor. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Crackle
docs.text:
Sapphire: Shoots pairs of homing shells at enemy targets. Carved Alloy: Shoots pairs of long-range shells that shatter upon contact into two super-piercing fragments. Periodically stops enemy units at the short time.

It has a built-in repair projector. In passive (inactive) state, repairs allied buildings and units in radius, while in the active state accumulates additional percentages for repairs. Requires hydrogen to work. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Cruelty
docs.text: Shoots a barrage of tungsten armor-piercing shells, periodically releasing a shell, which increases its damage with each shot that resets by reaching certain point. Requires a lot of heat and creotine to work. It gets damaged in the process. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Curvature
docs.text: Shoots a piercing blast at enemy targets. Throws piercing diamond shards at enemy targets, pulling the shards back. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Dawn
docs.text: Surge Alloy: Fires a shell releasing piercing blasts at enemy targets. Carved Alloy: Fires a massive explosive ball releasing a lot of energy particles. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Decay
docs.text: Fires a clusters of shells at ground targets. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Devotion
docs.text: Shoots an explosive energy ball at enemy targets. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Discharge
docs.text: Shoots high-speed shock bullets at enemy targets. Overdrive nearby buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Draw
docs.text: Makes a hit with blades, creating a piercing enemy targets blow. Breaking in the blade, the light takes the shape of the past. At the moment of impact, tearing the metal, inside the gap of the sword, you can see hundreds of battles that we will never remember. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Dublicity
docs.text: Shoots long-range erupting projectiles at enemy targets. Branch: Creostone

docs.title: Dune
docs.text: Fires a bouncing shells from silicon or creostone at enemy targets. Sand shells crumble at the first impact, slowing down enemy units. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Electron
docs.text: Causes overload on the attacked enemy unit, damaging it in the process. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Elimination
docs.text: Fires an armor-piercing supersonic frag shell at enemy targets. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Emerald EMP Cannon
docs.text: Fires explosive EMP projectile, dealing significant damage to enemy targets and repairing allied structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Endoxin
docs.text: Fires a large acid homing missiles at enemies. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Enlightenment
docs.text: Shoots a homing missile, spraying nearby gold dust on enemy targets. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Erazor
docs.text: Fires a high-speed piercing energy blade at enemy targets. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Combat Plant: Everfrost
docs.text: Fires a converted into a solid single-target crystal substance ledonite at ground targets. An impact mechanism is installed in the center, covering the area with a very cold frost. Creates a drone Shielder. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Executioner
docs.text: Prototype of a heavy ion weapon, high frequencies of radiation pass through the bodies of enemies and cause serious damage to electronics, disabling it.

docs.title: [#f25555]Failure[]
docs.text: Fires homing piercing ruby shard at enemy targets. Open the gate summoning special «Extinction» units with a certain chance.

docs.title: Fallen
docs.text: Transforms creotite substance into a steel-burning jet of the flame, directing it at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Flame
docs.text: Fires a burning bullets at enemy ground and aircraft, releasing a small fiery stream from the center. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Flight
docs.text: Fires a a swarm of small homing missiles at enemy targets. Prioritizes farthest enemies. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Frostbite
docs.text: Creates frag missiles from pieces of frozen liquid and fires at enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Glow
docs.text: Crystallizes atmospheric moisture into ice pins and fires them at enemies, piercing them. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Golden Horn
docs.text: The middle turret with a funny attack mechanism is effective against the crowd and is necessary to break through the back rows of enemy structures. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Greed
docs.text: Creates an energy needle piercing enemy targets, gradually increasing damage to a certain point and resetting it to its initial values. Damaged in the process. Requires argon to work. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Hawk
docs.text: Fires a long-range laser shell at enemy aircraft. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Heat
docs.text: Fires a burst of explosive projectiles at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Hoarfrost
docs.text: Fires an energy homing projectiles that cut through the air, create hoarfrost and pierce enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Icicle
docs.text: Crystallizes moisture into a freezing and piercing enemies beam. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Impaler
docs.text: Charges chunks of frozen liquid and launches at enemies, piercing them. Crystallizes atmospheric moisture into a fragment that pierce and overfreeze enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Inevitability
docs.text: Creates heavy amethyst needles capable of tearing and binding space itself. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Infinite Laser Array
docs.text: Continuously fires a laser beam at nearby enemies. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Injection
docs.text: Fires a piercing bullets at enemies. Periodically fires a piercing laser. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Launch
docs.text: Fires a homing high-speed missiles at enemies. Uses standard resources as ammunition. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Melinite
docs.text: Fires an acid bullets at enemies. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Multimortar
docs.text: Fires an artillery volley at ground targets. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Needle
docs.text: Fires a long-range piercing railgun bolt at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: North
docs.text: Fires freezing streams of energy at enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: [#fc8e6d]Oblivion[]
docs.text: Charges and fires a destructive sphere, hitting a large area. Open the gate summoning special units «Loss».

docs.title: Perfection
docs.text: Fires a high-energy erupting projectile, piercing enemies.

docs.title: Pierce
docs.text: Fires a burst of spheres, releasing a powerful piercing energy beam. Spawns Jerk units. Overdrive nearest buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Pulse
docs.text: Fires a laser bolt that damages enemies and repairs allied buildings. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Punch
docs.text: Fires a sapping explosive spheres at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Pyramid
docs.text: Fires a barrage of heavy frag artillery at ground targets. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Radiance
docs.text: Creates a mini-star that explodes on the spot several times.

docs.title: Rainfall
docs.text: Fires a homing armor piercing missiles formed from the water at enemy aircraft. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Reagent
docs.text: Fires an acid piercing shells and missiles at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Release
docs.text: Fires a sphere at enemy targets. The sphere is unstable, without reaching the target, it explodes and regenerates again, reaches the target and damages it, if the target is allied, repairs it. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Reproduction
docs.text: Fires a bullets from pieces of frozen liquid at enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Revival
docs.text: Fires a long-range emerald projectile that damages and immobilizes one target, and repairs allied buildings. The projectile splits into several homing energy clusters with repairing properties upon contact. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Sand Thrower
docs.text: Fires a heavy shells from sand or stone at enemy targets. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Sand Turret
docs.text: Shoots clusters of shells from sand or coal at ground targets. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Scarlet Star
docs.text: Charges and fires an energy sphere at ground targets. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Shelter
docs.text: Shoots continuous streams of flame at enemy targets. Pierce armor. It has a built-in repair projector, which in a passive state repairs nearby allied buildings and units, and in active state accumulates additional percentages for repairs. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Shine
docs.text: Fires a pieces of lead or diamond at enemies. Creates a Diamond Drone. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Shock
docs.text: Fires a pairs of electric bullets at enemies. Overdrive nearby buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Skull
docs.text: Fires a large diamond single-target bolt over long distances. A powerful blow provokes a shock wave, causing damage to the area. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Sorrow
docs.text: Fires a powerful beams of energy in combination, burning, melting and unmoving enemy targets. Requires creotine fuel. Branch: Creostone

docs.title: Sparrow
docs.text: Damages enemy aircraft in radius with bloody arcs. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Speed
docs.text: Fires a accelerating bullets at enemies. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Splash
docs.text: Fires a formed into a piercing projectile liquid at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Thrower
docs.text: Fires a piercing bullets at enemies. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Thrust
docs.text: Fires armor-piercing projectiles at enemy targets. Damages itself in the process, increasing own bullet's damage. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Toxin
docs.text: Fires an acid frag bullets at enemies. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Trembling
docs.text: Creates a powerful blow to the ground, shocking the nearest enemy ground units. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Waterdrop
docs.text: Fires an accelerating water, cryofluid or ledonite waterdrops at ground targets. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Wire
docs.text: Fires an electric bullets at ground targets. Overdrive nearby buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Adoptive Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades inputted units to the second tier.

docs.title: Base Fabricator
docs.text: Produces all types of units. Output units can be used directly, or moved into reconstructors for upgrading.

docs.title: Difference Drone Factory
docs.text: Produces «Difference» drones.

docs.title: Electronic Modifier
docs.text: Upgrades inputted units to the fourth tier.

docs.title: Factional Refabricator
docs.text: Upgrades units of all factions to third level.

docs.title: Faith Assembler
docs.text: Assemble fourth and fifth «Faith» unit levels using entered payloads. To assemble fifth level units requires an additional modules.

docs.title: Faith Fabricator
docs.text: Produces «Phenomenon» units.

docs.title: Faith Refabricator
docs.text: Upgrades «Phenomenon» units to second level «Loyalty»

docs.title: Ghost Assembler
docs.text: Assemble fourth and fifth «Ghost» unit levels using entered payloads. To assemble fifth level units requires an additional modules.

docs.title: Ghost Fabricator
docs.text: Produces «Presence» units.

docs.title: Ghost Refabricator
docs.text: Upgrades «Presence» units to second level «Apparition»

docs.title: Hunters Assembler
docs.text: Assemble fourth and fifth «Hunters» unit levels using entered payloads. To assemble fifth level units requires an additional modules.

docs.title: Hunters Fabricator
docs.text: Produces «Hound» units.

docs.title: Hunters Refabricator
docs.text: Upgrades «Hound» units to second level «Rampage»

docs.title: Innard Decrypter
docs.text: Upgrades inputted units to the final fifth tier.

docs.title: Logical Encoder
docs.text: Upgrades inputted units to the third tier.

docs.title: Regeneration Station
docs.text: Applies «Regeneration» status on damaged units in radius. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Amethyst
docs.text: Used in the creation of debuffing structures and ammunition.

docs.title: Carved alloy
docs.text: Strongest known material capable of absorbing surge and potential energy, converting it into mass, and is practically immune to various types of processing.

docs.title: Charged Cylinder
docs.text: Used in ultra-advanced power structures.

docs.title: Charged Ingot
docs.text: Used in a durable and fast-acting armament.

docs.title: Charged Lead
docs.text: Used in advanced power and electrical structures.

docs.title: Charged Stick
docs.text: Used to create structures and ammunition invisible to enemy attacks.

docs.title: Creostone
docs.text: Used in explosive and fire structures, and in homing ammunition.

docs.title: Cryo Cube
docs.text: Used as an additional source of cryofluid and in the construction of freezing facilities.

docs.title: Dense Alloy
docs.text: Is actively used in construction, almost every structure includes a dense alloy.

docs.title: Diamond
docs.text: Used in very expensive advanced structures, gives structure of buildings very well strength, and is used in exclusive ammunition.

docs.title: Emerald
docs.text: Used in repairing structures and ammunition.

docs.title: Globium
docs.text: Used in fast electrical equipment in ammunition.

docs.title: Ice cube
docs.text: Used as an additional water source and used in turret ammunition.

docs.title: Ledonite Cube
docs.text: Used in glacial structures and as cooling.

docs.title: Ruby
docs.text: Used in reinforcing structures and in viral ammunition.

docs.title: Sapphire
docs.text: Used in defensive structures and ammunition. Gives buildings the ability to absorb lasers and electric arcs.

docs.title: Stone
docs.text: Used in the construction of fortified structures and in ammunition.

docs.title: Surge Stone
docs.text: Used in electrical weapons equipment.

docs.title: Tinorium
docs.text: A crystalline substance obtained by synthesis from carbon isotopes and thorium rocks. It can be regarded as an energy source due to its radioactive properties.

docs.title: Topaz
docs.text: Used in liquid distribution/storage structures, creation of special turrets and units.

docs.title: Argon
docs.text: Used in production, unit constructions and fuel. Inert.

docs.title: Creotine
docs.text: Used in power production and as good fuel. Very explosive and flammable.

docs.title: Creotite
docs.text: A combustible and explosive substance used as a fuel and as a component for creation of other similar substances.

docs.title: Ledonite
docs.text: Used in extreme cooling and in glacial structures.

docs.title: Surge Mass
docs.text: Used for the production of high-power materials and the production of huge amounts of power. The mass charge is extremely unstable.

docs.title: Afterdark
docs.text: An abandoned cave with the remains of useful equipment was seen in this area. However, the enemy does not want to give up this area without a fight.

docs.title: Calamity
docs.text: Place, time, accident... Conclusion... History of this place can be a good starting point for a new word in electricity.

docs.title: Duality
docs.text: Carefully, we are on the battlefield, dont go far from core or enemy Whirlpools can cause huge amount of problems.

docs.title: Fallen Legion
docs.text: There is testing field of creotite technologies in this sector, they left traces of ledonite and huge funnel with useful raw materials from which several blueprints can be synthesized.

docs.title: Greyland
docs.text: Here stretches a rocky valley containing large reserves of useful materials for production. Melt dense alloy in as many quantities as possible. Repel massive enemy attacks.

docs.title: Mess
docs.text: Topaz veins are spreading across the area, which the enemy is actively digging up and producing structures using topaz. The enemy is producing units from different sides, attack their base as soon as possible. After intelligence, you discover deposits of small sizes, similar to sapphire and amethyst. Do not let the enemy take the discovered resources. Topaz Mine, Rift and Argon Boreholes, place them on gas rifts, extract Argon. Topaz is becoming the main target in the near future, Sapphire and Amethyst are being put on the back burner.

docs.title: Pressure
docs.text: Enemy team Malis have water Fortress here. But nowadays this fortress is fallen and endure the massive attack, so you have some advantage to stole technologies from the opponents.

docs.title: Requiem
docs.text: Clocks are going by changing years... And the time takes everything... Now your fate of the present era... Leads you to the latest ding...

docs.title: Active Blood Rage
docs.text: Active programmable virus overloading the system. Dramatically increases the characteristics at the cost of health and protection of a unit.

docs.title: Golden Pollination
docs.text: Covers enemy units with gold dust, making them heavier, which slows them down. As the hull of enemy units is covered with gold particles, they become even stronger.

docs.title: Overload
docs.text: A created electrical overvoltage of the enemy. Interaction with fire will cause great harm.

docs.title: Passive Blood Rage
docs.text: Passive auxiliary virus that, when merged with active blood rage, will cause even more harm.

docs.title: Regeneration
docs.text: Performs treatment and reinforcement of a combat unit.

docs.title: Shock Stun
docs.text: Completely immobilizes an enemy unit with an electric discharge, causing damage when interacting with moisture.

docs.title: Stun
docs.text: Completely immobilizes enemy units, temporarily depriving them of the opportunity to attack.

docs.title: Abyss Spawn
docs.text: Fires weakening homing missiles at enemy targets. Protects area with force field. Automatically rebuilds broken structures. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Apparition
docs.text: Shoots repulsive ruby shells. Branch: Ruby

docs.title: Aspiration
docs.text: Defends Purple Night core from enemies. Repairs the nearest buildings and accelerates the nearest units. Sapping enemy units that fall within sapping field range. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Beam
docs.text: A light mobile ship that uses energy to form light. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Diamond Drone
docs.text: Fires a diamond shells. Assist Shine turret. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Difference
docs.text: Performs various functions, depending on the selected command. Automatically mines beryllium, tungsten, sapphire and amethyst, depositing it into the core. Automatically rebuilds destroyed structures and assist other units in construction. Automatically repairs damaged buildings. Increases speed of closest buildings. Capable of carrying blocks and small ground units.

docs.title: Fight
docs.text: Defends Victory core from enemies. Equipped with a minigun and homing projectiles. When destroyed, drops the Second Chance turret. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Firmament
docs.text: Defends core Tesla from enemies. Shoots a frag shell, damaging enemies and repairing allied buildings. Releases a wave that repairs nearby allied buildings and units when destroyed. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Flood
docs.text: Defends Ocean core from enemies. Equipped with jerk motors. Not very stable. Fires a beam bullets and homing water bomb. Periodically accelerates the reloading of weapons and increases its health. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Flow
docs.text: Defends core «Energon» from enemies. Launches a hail of homing shock projectiles that deal significant damage to enemy powered buildings, increasing the speed of their turrets. Deals a percentage of damage in area that depends on enemy's buildings max health, slowing them down. Doesn't slows down enemy turrets. Repairs allied buildings with projectiles. Stuns all enemy units and buildings that fall into its energy field. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Gaze
docs.text: Fires a volley of ruby projectiles that slows down the enemy buildings and cause significant damage to buildings with power, and shoots a piercing projectile at enemy targets. Slows down and damages enemy units with an oppressive field. Branch: Ruby

docs.title: Glaive
docs.text: Shoots fiery repulsive bullets at aerial targets. Creature spawned by fire.

docs.title: Glare
docs.text: A flying unit that uses capsules with diamonds in the form of a cartridge, when broken, they give out a powerful pulse of light. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Gripper
docs.text: Shoots repulsive and piercing ruby projectiles. Branch: Ruby

docs.title: Jerk
docs.text: Burns through enemy targets with a continuous laser. Shoots twisting bullets, stunning enemy targets. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Lambda
docs.text: Defends Cage core from enemies. Builds structures. Can damage enemy structures.

docs.title: Luminary
docs.text: An average ship has capacitors inside it that collect light into a kind of charge. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Ooze
docs.text: Fires a volley of massive ruby shells, dealing 2× damage to enemy powered buildings, and slowdown other buildings. Damages and slows down enemy units with Oppression Aura. Branch: Ruby

docs.title: Presence
docs.text: Shoots piercing ruby shells. Branch: Ruby

docs.title: Prophecy
docs.text: A mobile heavy ship that has weapons for constantly burning the enemy, this has pros and cons... It also has a special type of weapon previously unknown. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Scarlet Moth
docs.text: Builds structures to defend Scarlet Gem core from enemies. Fires ruby missiles at nearby targets. At zero health, it transforms into a Scarlet Guard unit. Strengthens nearby ally units at the cost of their health. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Shriek
docs.text: A heavy assault ship that is equipped with a pair of large massive fragmentation guns. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Snowflake
docs.text: Defends the Snow Monolith core from enemies. Fires a frosty bullets at enemies. Freezes the area around, dealing damage when moving. Drops an ice bomb when destroyed. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Sound
docs.text: A small flying unit that fires laser bolts that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Star
docs.text: Balanced in size ship, allowing you not to lose speed in battle. Carries heavy shock weapons, but sacrifices the strength of the hull. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Trident
docs.text: Defends Emerald Core from enemies. Drops bombs that damage enemies and repair allied buildings. Builds structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Tune
docs.text: Fires a bombs that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Vibration
docs.text: A medium-sized ship firing explosive shells that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Virus
docs.text: Fires homing and sapping missiles. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: War
docs.text: Defends Triumph core from enemies. Fires a cluster of energy clumps at nearby targets. Spawns Virus units when destroyed. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Whisper
docs.text: A hovering ship capable of extracting extremely hard resources. Fires a supersonic projectiles that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Absorption
docs.text: Protects Adynamia with an arc shield. Invisible, hidden from enemy attacks. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Blaster
docs.text: Fires a massive charged crumbling sphere from the left cannon, and fires charged bullets at enemy targets from the right weapon. Absorbs enemy projectiles with an arc shield. It self-destructs over time. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Cold Blood
docs.text: The frost giant, capable of turning its opponents into an amalgam of ice, fires a heavy piercing charges. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Cult
docs.text: A weighty unit capable of moving through some areas of the terrain. It fires piercing impact projectiles at enemies. Produces «Phenomenon» units. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Degree
docs.text: Its partially frozen bullets are partially made of water and do not cause much damage. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Emptiness
docs.text: A mech with short-range impact-type weapons. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Epitaph
docs.text: Pure Force Of Machinery The first unit of the superheavy class of military equipment. Equipped with a piercing long beam, and a pair of heavy machine guns. Type: Boss

docs.title: Fatum
docs.text: The Voice Beyond The Edges Of The Cosmos A mechanized communication station, inflicts damage by residual radiation from the equipment and strikes from the "Destiny" orbital station. Type: Boss

docs.title: Hole
docs.text: The simplest unit, uses advanced ammunition. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Hound
docs.text: A combat unit that is simple in structure and has built-in suppressed protocols. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Hunt
docs.text: Mech. Capable of immobilizing, tracking... [Suppressed], They attack with the left hand - shotgun. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Ice Bomb
docs.text: Exploding, freezes the area around, damaging enemies in the affected area.

docs.title: Loyalty
docs.text: A medium-weight unit capable of crossing certain terrain. It's shotguns firing hitscan shells. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Maw
docs.text: Perfect, Come HERE, Hunger, Food, Goodbye. [Suppression: Rejected] Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Milestone
docs.text: A massive walker moving over the terrain. It is equipped with two pairs of guns, as well as a single type, which dispels several explosive shells with delayed action. The first pair of guns fires armor-piercing shells, the second pair fires a burst of several armor-piercing shells that punch through enemies. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Nihil
docs.text: A one-of-a-kind family of mechs that rejected weapon technology and adopted the power of melee combat. Makes jerks forward with a swing of the claws. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Penance
docs.text: A large walker moving over the terrain. Shoots bouncing projectiles. It is equipped with a hitscan railgun. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Phenomenon
docs.text: A light unit capable of moving across some terrain. It is equipped with point guns firing hitscan bullets. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Rampage
docs.text: Extremely mobile mech capable of absorbing enemy energy. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: [#8b73c7]Rapix[]
docs.text: Fires piercing frag bullets, creating a shield around itself that damages enemy targets when it reaches its target area.

docs.title: Raptor
docs.text: Fires a volley of projectiles from the left cannon. Fires overpowering shell that summons «Rampage». The Ultimate Hunter. Flock, TRACK, [Suppressed]. Heavy mech, has built-in reconstructors. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Scarlet Guard
docs.text: A sturdy multi-legged unit firing a barrage of ruby missiles at nearby targets. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Second Chance
docs.text: Fires a long-range piercing railgun bolt at the selected target. Elemental Faction: Lightning
